body:
Derek Schmidt believes in putting the Kansas economy first. We cannot thrive as a state if we are focused on raising taxes and following the disastrous leadership of the federal government.| | |
---
| | Friend,**

**[Derek Schmidt believes in putting the Kansas economy first.](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=3006b08b5a8e4bf59b164d6cefc9ffc6&_e=6m3EQVdypKE-4gG6WQNdi100qO9ul-UmSjlNyTbJWtye3WpDKYITwywiH5sH9MCLRZVemzO6u_gjcWLJ7aVuw9DFGgGnz_Qry0WDvG-bzeFVNs4KwkT9ZJ9y1_2KmSvGP5Pwt1jdUeS5MES2JZ9she6Q13OFm2cMyoXoBlhrQuOhWZl_LK9phFi8tTr0TljQysX-m0FSbma786D_0-C2xmncXQlfLmkd74iW0I-nJEA%3D) We cannot thrive as a state if we are focused on raising taxes and following the disastrous leadership of the federal government. Sadly, almost 20,000 fewer Kansans are employed in our state today than four years ago, and Kansas is one of the worst-performing states in recovering the more than 157,000 jobs destroyed during Governor Kelly’s COVID-19 lockdowns. Kansas must never repeat her disastrous decision to deem certain jobs “non-essential.” Every job and every paycheck is essential. **This is Derek’s plan for growing a healthy state economy:****
**
✔️ Propose to the Legislature a constitutional amendment to protect long-term transportation funding and permanently close the ‘Bank of KDOT.’ ✔️ Prioritize finishing the US-69 four-lane expansion in Southeast Kansas and bring four-lane access to Southwest Kansas, while setting a goal of a four-lane highway connecting Southeast Kansas, Wichita, and Southwest Kansas. Four-lane access across southern Kansas will help existing businesses thrive and attract long-term economic development and investment throughout the region. ✔️ Establish and empower a task force to work with local agriculture and community leaders on managing and sustaining water, our state’s most vital natural resource. ✔️ Partner with the Board of Regents and with public and private colleges, technical schools, and universities to capitalize on postsecondary education as an economic development engine for Kansas. ✔️ Require able-bodied adults with no dependents to work in order to receive public benefits paid for by hardworking taxpayers. ✔️ Review, identify, and eliminate ineffective and job-killing regulations and unnecessary licensing requirements. ✔️ Fix the broken unemployment benefits system that failed Kansans under the Kelly administration. Kansas small businesses are feeling the pain of Kelly’s policies and are backing Derek Schmidt for governor. Derek Schmidt has been endorsed by: The National Federation of Independent Business Kansas Political Action Committee, Kansas Chamber of Commerce Political Action Committee, and has received support from the Wichita Chamber of Commerce Political Action Committee. Kansans can’t afford another four years of Laura Kelly and Joe Biden. Peter,

### **Supporters,**

It's officially November which marks seven days until Election Day. First off, I wanted to profess my profound gratitude to those who have supported me on this journey. It's been a wild ride that I couldn't have done without my family, team, and supporters beside me. It's been such a great experience to be able to speak with voters throughout the community and act as their vessel for change.

The people of this country are fed up with the status quo, they want to see results, not just partisan parroting. That is why my entire campaign has been focused on _No Sides, Just Solutions,_ unlike my opponent!

In addition to our hard work, turnout is low among registered Democrats across Dallas County. This is the first, and could be the only, chance to flip this district in over three decades.

With these last few days of campaigning, we could use all the support we can get. # [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=1167%2E61531%2EDvCxNS)
Hey team, it’s Ryan. Peter’s campaign manager.
All the hard work we’ve put into this movement has been leading up to this moment — **we’re exactly one week out from Election Day!** And the team here at Welch HQ couldn’t be more thrilled to approach this final stretch with the support of this grassroots team.
One week out means that Peter and the team are traveling across the state, knocking on doors, meeting voters where they’re at, and talking about what really matters.
As we approach this final week and people finalize their plans to vote — early in person, returning their absentee ballots in person, or voting in person on Election Day — whatever your plan is, [**we hope you’ll chip in $3 or anything you can to fund our Get Out The Vote efforts to ensure we’re able to reach as many Vermonters as possible.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4830?t=3&akid=1167%2E61531%2EDvCxNS)
Thanks so much!
Ryan McLaren
Campaign Manager, Welch for Vermont
**PS: We promised you a fun fact a day until Election Day and we’re delivering. Here’s today’s fun fact: Did you know that Peter is a huge Rihanna fan? With that in mind, we’ve created something special so you can enjoy some upbeat tunes to keep the vibes right! Check out our Get Out The Vote playlist to hear a few of his favorites![Listen here.](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4827?t=4&akid=1167%2E61531%2EDvCxNS)**

body:
| [ ](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/32069?t=6&akid=5179%2E878179%2ExtmFs3) Wow, I just stepped off the stage at a grassroots rally with President Barack Obama and I am more fired up and inspired to fight than I've ever been. [**Please, will you rush a split donation of $10 between my campaign and Voter Protection Project to join President Obama in powering our movement to protect Nevada's Senate seat and our Democratic majority?**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/32069?t=7&akid=5179%2E878179%2ExtmFs3) Together, President Obama and I spoke to Nevada voters about everything that's on the line in this race - reproductive rights, our Democratic Senate majority, the future of free and fair elections and our very democracy. **Truly, all of it comes down to whether I hold this seat - because if we lose, Democrats cannot hold the Senate.**

**So there is grave cause for concern:** as we were on stage, and as I write to you now, Mitch McConnell is bombarding Nevada's airwaves with ads viciously attacking me - **just as new polling shows me statistically tied with my Trump-backed opponent.**

I left the stage feeling so hopeful, but that hope is now mixed with unease about McConnell's newest barrage of attack ads. I'm worried that if we're outspent and drowned out on the airwaves in these final days, with minimal resources to fight back, we will lose. **My team and I set a goal to raise $500,000 before the end of the rally because it 's our ONLY chance of winning this race, but I just heard we fell short. We absolutely cannot fall short at moments like this: [Please, will you split $10 between my campaign and Voter Protection Project to help President Obama and me keep Nevada and the Senate blue?](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/32069?t=8&akid=5179%2E878179%2ExtmFs3)** If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Catherine Cortez Masto and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/32070?t=9&akid=5179%2E878179%2ExtmFs3)

We have 7 _days_ left to tip the scales in this deadlocked race, and I know we can do it if we all do our part. Thank you so much for being on my team.

_¡ La lucha sigue!_ The fight continues!

Catherine

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

subject: WEEKLY UPDATE!
body:
[https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/Gpjpp30oGxJ-Qa37Yc933kTB9Bf5uY8M9IGy7E5NOSWaXuaY8rQ-qsGBhBDxLVu9ot4sBiITQesUFDN7bbonKSqJqyQfhRjtNOhsCJfcFrG4Ydl4P7C8NoZW6JkkZFlvHSkf_-BfH2Vy93gU1CLd6yHbnSMa7og-WqoVBgtvwrQpw8cPniSyjyPRjg]

1 WEEK UNTIL ELECTION DAY!!!

1 week until the General Election! We are in the homestretch and the events are more important than ever before. Please attend as many of these events as you can and bring your friends and family!!! This is so important as we head towards the finish line.

Here is what is coming up:

WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 2nd

Metro Stop Lit Drop: Wednesday, Nov 2, 4:30 - 6:30pm. We are looking for volunteers to sign up to hand out flyers at the metro stops in Arlington and Falls Church. Sign up today! https://www.signupgenius.com/go/30e0448a4aa23aafb6-karina

Rally Prep: Wednesday, Nov 2, 1 - 2pm. Campaign HQ, Alexandria. Help us prepare for the Rally with Gov Youngkin. We will be blowing up balloons and gathering supplies. If you plan to attend, please email Schedule@KarinaForCongress.com

THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 3rd

Rally with Gov Youngkin: Thursday, Nov 3, 2pm. Mason District Park, 6621 Columbia Pike, Annandale. Hosted by: Spirit of Virginia PAC. Invite your friends and come show your support for Karina. Wear your Karina t-shirts. RSVP Here: https://www.eventbrite.com/e/early-vote-stop-w-special-guests-gov-youngkin-jim-myles-karina-lipsman-tickets-445320424377

FRIDAY, NOVEMBER 4th

Veterans Appreciation Night: Friday, Nov 4, 7:00pm. VFW Post 9274, 7118 Shreve Rd, Falls Church. Hosted by CAPA NOVA. All veterans are encouraged to attend.

SATURDAY, NOVEMBER 5th

Early Voting For Karina: Saturday, Nov 5, 9 - 10:30am. Whitman Middle School Parking Lot, 2500 Parkers Ln, Alexandria. Coffee & donuts provided. Come hear Karina's message then walk the Mt Vernon Government Center polling location to vote! Only Fairfax County voters can vote, but all can come and show your support. Let us know you are coming! RSVP: https://tinyurl.com/EarlyVoting11-5

[https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/kwDEEZOPwY5sOUXj60dJjNRsSO2jFMZpOMORz6747bG7pv64bhj22GUw8snCLa1hatQYc3F2H9yiWeukp20v_zrbMuQXDkkEsDgcoNIjOe64OQVl_PkOaF9ItlM_iiC-nWqUyEtdGeQUJeZgUxIbyvqCpeMuqsDQxRKGzASwuiTLpSm497bqP0cPNQ]

MONDAY, NOVEMBER 7th

Rally with Gov Youngkin: Monday, Nov 7, 11am. Lee District Park, 7900 Lee Hwy, Falls Church. Hosted by: Spirit of Virginia PAC. Invite your friends and come show your support for Karina. Wear your Karina t-shirts. RSVP Here: https://www.eventbrite.com/e/gotv-rally-with-special-guests-gov-youngkin-jim-myles-karina-lipsman-tickets-445326833547

Election Eve Fireside Party: Monday, Nov 7, 5:00-7:00pm. Campaign HQ, Alexandria. Hosted by: Karina For Congress. All volunteers are invited to come enjoy some social time and to pick-up the last of the signs for distribution for Election Day. Refreshments around the fire pit will be provided. RSVP here: https://tinyurl.com/FiresideParty

[https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/xxazhnFpKSOOdWTUVjyLdoVhfSWWYmqWnGWoJ8iqdIhpMs8kS_C09IoLAyE7vJNY-65RjSJofbc4RCWQ61Xj9-aj2syA12VCrFQANKOSunxLyzB1Ucy8n6BwisfCW1CQTDqcH1dsq8n666zEmfr9wy4gJM4mac9GfhX4p2TKVyWL5if4M8LO3Skptg]

ELECTION NIGHT

TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 8th

Election Night Party: Tuesday, Nov 8, 6:30pm. Arlington Rooftop Bar & Grill. Hosted by: Karina For Congress. Come watch the election results with the rest of the volunteers who worked hard for the campaign. RSVP: https://tinyurl.com/ElectionParty11-8 <https://tinyurl.com/ElectionParty11-8>

[https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/NCuXwdOe7OWw5r0eePsQIbjT5RabfWxip19nNwicuqYeRSm_46rPzG2D9cH1jFOI2O7VsZ-dQHvZMwG1xMtWGdztVNcWvgxG8CE2zj9LD4PWfwRSpgUw-hylAGR_G7_ebY0np8_se-wfh3UkbodGxrPheiBk0xHBNbeVwTyag2kLchx2vh3CbcRpkw]

Need signs for your yard? Please submit your request here: https://www.karinaforcongress.com/jointeamkarina (Click on the red words "Click here to request a yard sign").

Check out our Events Page that is updated daily with event information and links: https://www.karinaforcongress.com/events

The Karina Lipsman HQ Office is open Wednesdays and Thursdays at 10am to 4pm. If you need to stop by, please email Schedule@KarinaForCongress.com to get the address and confirm availability.

Be sure to follow Karina on Twitter (https://twitter.com/KarinaCongress), Instagram (https://www.instagram.com/karinaforcongress/), and Facebook (https://www.facebook.com/KarinaforCongress). Please "like", "share" and/or "retweet" to get her message out to everyone.

clean_body: We have a choice between hope, unity, and optimism or fear, division, and darkness. | | Derek, in seven days, Americans have a choice between hope, unity, and optimism or fear, division, and darkness. When you helped elect Joe and me in 2020, that was just the beginning of our fight to build a better America. Now, with so little time before the midterms, we need to keep our foot on the gas. Can I count on you to make your first $7 donation of the year to protect our majorities and defend our progress in just seven days? If Republicans take back Congress, they’ll continue their attacks on our fundamental freedoms. While Democrats fight to lower costs for workers and families, Republicans are working to put Social Security and Medicare on the chopping block. I believe in what we can do together, and I believe that we can expand our progress and defend our majorities. I’m calling on you: Thank you for all that you do, Kamala Kamala Harris Vice President of the United States Kamala Harris: Derivative of Adam Schultz / Biden for President Photo. [600x300] [==] Supreme Court likely to ban affirmative action in college admissions, legal experts say [==] Source: Fox News [==] After lengthy and heated oral arguments Monday, Supreme Court experts say the justices are likely to bar the use of affirmative action in college admissions. The court heard two similar cases on the use of race in college admissions at Harvard University and the University of North Carolina in a nearly five-hour session. An activist group called Students for Fair Admissions brought both cases, and seemed to have more justices on its side. Derek,

This email is going to be a long one. But with so many important races
happening around the country, we wanted to sum up all the information you
need to know about what’s happening on the ground here in Georgia in our
campaign to elect Stacey Abrams.

understand. With just under a week left, here’s the most important thing:
that you donate $25 — or even $5 — to ensure
we have the resources we need to reach voters and get across the finish
line. Time is of the essence in a race this close, and Stacey needs
everyone behind her to finish strong.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/6203?refcode=sa_em_221101_B6_LongButImportant_S1_T1_TA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=16626%2E1862389%2EGYdiUA ]DONATE

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

FACT #1: Early voting numbers are reaching historic levels and are
reflecting the momentum behind Stacey’s vision.

ATLANTA JOURNAL-CONSTITUTION:

“If voting continues at its current pace, overall turnout is expected to easily
surpass [2018].”

Early Vote in Georgia this year is like nothing we’ve seen before in a
midterm election. We’re seeing unprecedented numbers of voters come out to
cast their ballots, despite the hurdles that Brian Kemp and his allies
have placed before them.

But we only have until Friday to get as many voters as possible to the
polls before Early Vote closes. So we need every Stacey Abrams supporter
on board right now.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/6203?refcode=sa_em_221101_B6_LongButImportant_S1_T1_TA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1004&akid=16626%2E1862389%2EGYdiUA ]Derek, make
your next
$5 donation right now so we can keep our momentum going
strong, turn out a historic number of voters in the last few days of Early
Vote and finally elect Stacey Abrams as governor of this great state.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/6203?refcode=sa_em_221101_B6_LongButImportant_S1_T1_TA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1005&akid=16626%2E1862389%2EGYdiUA ]DONATE

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

FACT #2: Brian Kemp has signed into law one of the most restrictive
abortion bans in the country, and at this week’s debate he said that he’ll
prosecute doctors, too.

BRIAN KEMP:

“[U]nder this piece of legislation...[d]octors who perform illegal abortions would
be [prosecuted].” Gwinnett Daily Post, 10.30.2022”

Already under Brian Kemp, nearly all abortions are illegal. Because his
restrictions start at 6 weeks — before many women even know they’re
pregnant — Brian Kemp will begin to treat doctors as if they’re criminals.
And to make matters worse, at the debate he didn’t deny he’d be open to
even more restrictions on abortion if re-elected.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/6203?refcode=sa_em_221101_B6_LongButImportant_S1_T1_TA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1006&akid=16626%2E1862389%2EGYdiUA ]Brian Kemp’s campaign against women and their bodies is on the ballot
right now,
Derek. In just a few days,
Election Day will be here and reproductive rights for Georgians may be
decided for generations. Will you chip in $5 right now as
the window of opportunity closes to save women’s rights in Georgia?

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/6203?refcode=sa_em_221101_B6_LongButImportant_S1_T1_TA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1007&akid=16626%2E1862389%2EGYdiUA ]DONATE

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

FACT #3: The media has underestimated this campaign more times than we can
count.

GEORGIA PUBLIC BROADCASTING:

“Could Abrams ride Georgia’s record midterm early-vote surge to outperform the
polls?”

Time and again, year after year, we’ve come across articles and op-eds
that have underestimated the energy for Stacey’s vision and a Democratic
Georgia that we know exists here on the ground. And our historic Early
Vote numbers speak for themselves.

We know the polls won’t reflect the energy that’s driven almost two
million Georgians to the ballot box already.

And Stacey sees Georgians, regardless of whether the polls see them or
not.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/6203?refcode=sa_em_221101_B6_LongButImportant_S1_T1_TA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1008&akid=16626%2E1862389%2EGYdiUA ]So, let’s throw our all behind Stacey and focus on the only polls that
matter,
Derek. Because once those
polls close on Election Night, your window to be a part of history might
close for good. Can you chip in $5 right now to power
Stacey Abrams to victory in the final days of our campaign?

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/6203?refcode=sa_em_221101_B6_LongButImportant_S1_T1_TA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1009&akid=16626%2E1862389%2EGYdiUA ]DONATE

There’s 1 week left in this race, so we need all cylinders firing. We hope
we can count on you,
Derek.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/6203?refcode=sa_em_221101_B6_LongButImportant_S1_T1_TA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1010&akid=16626%2E1862389%2EGYdiUA ]Winning this race will take a historic effort. But with your support,
we know we can do it. If you invest $25 — or even

final stretch.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/6203?refcode=sa_em_221101_B6_LongButImportant_S1_T1_TA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1011&akid=16626%2E1862389%2EGYdiUA ]DONATE

Thanks for reading through this email and showing up for us.

Team Abrams

body:
Derek,

Tonight at midnight is our one week until Election Day deadline, and we
still have a $7,412 budget gap.

Closing this gap is critical to ensuring we can fully fund our
get-out-the-vote operation across Wisconsin, and falling short on our

name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: My story in pictures
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
| |
---
| | | Peter,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I decided to run for U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61779303:624bFsGKN:m:1:3331421248:E6C4BD116698DF6F969822750CCABE22:r "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61779303:624bFsGKN:m:1:3331421248:E6C4BD116698DF6F969822750CCABE22:r "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61779303:624bFsGKN:m:1:3331421248:E6C4BD116698DF6F969822750CCABE22:r "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61779303:624bFsGKN:m:1:3331421248:E6C4BD116698DF6F969822750CCABE22:r "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61779303:624bFsGKN:m:1:3331421248:E6C4BD116698DF6F969822750CCABE22:r "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and
every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61779303:624bFsGKN:m:1:3331421248:E6C4BD116698DF6F969822750CCABE22:r "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind
active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61779303:624bFsGKN:m:1:3331421248:E6C4BD116698DF6F969822750CCABE22:r "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an
advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61779303:624bFsGKN:m:1:3331421248:E6C4BD116698DF6F969822750CCABE22:r "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family has decided to take on a new challenge. I made the choice to run for U.S. Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61779303:624bFsGKN:m:1:3331421248:E6C4BD116698DF6F969822750CCABE22:r "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique
problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, Peter. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61779303:624bFsGKN:m:1:3331421248:E6C4BD116698DF6F969822750CCABE22:r "So please, can you chip in just a
few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. ")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61779303:624bFsGKN:m:1:3331421248:E6C4BD116698DF6F969822750CCABE22:r "KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61779303:624bFsGKN:m:1:3331421248:E6C4BD116698DF6F969822750CCABE22:r "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

name: Grace Jo
subject: Some people aren’t so lucky…
body:
I was born in the socialist dictatorship of North Korea. I managed to escape, but it wasn’t easy...
[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zpndop7vqe3rc72jte9t3n93htp6ee158n1q55jo_rp22sh2s8i66or7cpgecoj0sth2bs)
Hello Friend,

I was born in the socialist dictatorship of North Korea. I managed to escape, but it wasn't easy...

I tried several times before, but each time, my family and I were repatriated to North Korea by the Chinese government and imprisoned upon our return.

I finally escaped for good in 2006, but not without help. _Pastor Philip Buck bribed North Korean agents with $10,000_ to let me, my mother, and my sister (my only remaining family members) leave for China.

But I'm still one of the lucky ones.

There are over 25 MILLION people trapped inside North Korea.

**Now I am a speaker with the Dissident Project.** The Dissident Project brings
survivors of authoritarian socialist countries to high schools around the United States to tell them about our experiences.

I want to share my story and remind high school students how lucky they are to live in a free country and how dangerous authoritarianism can be.

**That 's why we've set a goal to raise $10,000 before the end of October to send speakers to more high schools this year.**

[_**Can you donate $10, $35, $50, or any generous amount so I can share my story with high school students? Click here to give today >>>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z8bu9bbbhul7pvbjivqf40hc5kha6v7n2fent85g_rp22sh2s8i66or7cpgecoj0sth2bs)

Too many young people are taught to believe the United States is an evil, oppressive country and that capitalism is a failure.

But they have no ideas what an oppressive country really is!

They don't realize that millions have lost their lives due to hunger or North Korea's brutality, and very few ever have the chance to escape.

**In fact, I am 1 of only 400 refugees from North Korea in the U.S. **

Very few Americans have probably had the chance to meet someone from North Korea, much less have the opportunity to talk with them and ask questions.

**The Dissident Project gives high school students a rare, first-hand account of what happens inside an actual oppressive state like North Korea. **

Your generous donation can give high school students a new perspective and teach them to respect, protect, and enjoy the freedom we have in this country.

[_**You can give high school students a once-in-a-lifetime experience.**__**All you have to do is click here**_ _**and donate any amount today >>>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zhunobdphc50obp13v9h9ep1k2oubb4ufb34t198_rp22sh2s8i66or7cpgecoj0sth2bs)

We teach high school students about the dangers of authoritarian socialism and explain the principles that have made America prosperous and why we must defend them.

And every school we visit introduces these ideas to hundreds of students.

The Dissident Project speakers have already reached 2,000 students. And we have 25 additional talks and counting scheduled for this school year alone!

_It 's your support that allows us to provide these talks at no cost to schools_.

Every dollar we raise allows us to impact students with the stories of people who survived and escaped authoritarian socialist countries.

Can you give a gift to the Dissident Program and help speakers like me share our stories? **Click any button to send your donation.**

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z615tq56rcuptqo16dcoo4g4k3lhgf17ls2v06vo_rp22sh2s8i66or7cpgecoj0sth2bs)

This information may be common sense to you, but it’s not to many of your friends and family, especially the elderly.

FIVE Actions You Can Take to Protect Maryland Elections:

- VOTE ON ELECTION DAY: All Marylanders must vote in person, one day only, on November 8th. Absolutely no early voting and no mail in ballots.

name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: My story in pictures
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
I wanted to share these special moments with you. [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c920805%7c6218%7c7%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c0&wdmdk=yqEhhRLqRKlfHKS%2fR1p%2bjw&sysid=1)
I wanted to share these special moments with you.

| |
---
| | | Friend,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I decided to run for U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80973%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=UiTNMS3%2bEQruHsqMIyN3sg&sysid=1 "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80974%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Or3%2fV9YXPzrhtHVcTSuStQ&sysid=1 "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80985%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=y7L%2bvw7pQPFR74mkqkhcKQ&sysid=1 "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty’s side.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80986%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=zd6pTyNA2zwDpk9c1eXnDw&sysid=1 "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty’s immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80987%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=teiShZ6UDbEONmB7DrP4LA&sysid=1 "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran
gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80988%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=cey9KUgm%2baDFlhhN4qejZw&sysid=1 "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer,
breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It’s not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80989%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=9ljZM6boRvUdN1QCUBSQug&sysid=1 "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for
our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to ‘see’ our children’s faces, he’s always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80980%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=AeZtEmbh%2f0qC71tBuoS3qA&sysid=1 "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family has decided to take on a new challenge. I made the choice to run for U.S. Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I’ve shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80981%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=aMyKo4ZIZkr90uaDfTowwg&sysid=1 "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and
end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can’t do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far.](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80982%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=GaK4WHBAjwBakYZQEWujuA&sysid=1 "So please, can you chip in just a few bucks
to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. ")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80983%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Wf7J00TCxWWKgxyOobZ9LQ&sysid=1 "KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80984%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=tdAsuCt5heYcBhJEfC2Vlg&sysid=1 "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---

I just had to send this to you again today to remind you of what’s at stake in this election.

Derek, I wanted to forward you a message that Josh Shapiro sent on June 24, 2022 — the day _Roe v. Wade_ was overturned by the Supreme Court. It still hurts to think that women across the nation no longer have access to vital reproductive health care and can’t make decisions about their own bodies. But I just had to send this to you again today to remind you of what’s at stake in this election. **The next Governor of Pennsylvania will have the power to decide if abortion remains legal here. Let’s make sure we elect a pro-choice Governor in Josh Shapiro.[Donate right now to fuel his fight to defend our abortion access in the last 6 days of this election.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53851976/376686893/360385765?refcode=email_110222_fwdabortion_allactive&amount=5&amounts=5,15,25,50,100&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NmI1YTA1OS05ZjVhLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DKp_-FFSp3doN2gHaw1rVlE6wCuKrK6La0VQx47-Zs4=)** Thanks, Dana Fritz
Campaign Manager
Shapiro for Pennsylvania P.S. Read Josh’s original message below: ———————FWD——————— From: Josh Shapiro
Subject line: It’s official, Roe v. Wade has been overturned
Date sent: June 24, 2022 Derek, it’s official: _Roe v. Wade_ has been overturned by the U.S. Supreme Court. It’s been a hard few weeks since this decision was leaked, but now it’s real — and I’m sure you’re angry, frustrated, and scared about what this means. I am too. **But this decision means the next Governor will have the ability to sign — or veto — that legislation. Derek, I will veto any bill that restricts a woman’s right to choose — and with today’s news, we know that’s going to be one of the most consequential decisions our next Governor makes.** **[Derek, we must win this race to keep abortion safe, legal, and accessible in Pennsylvania. It is literally up to us. Can you donate whatever feels right to you in this moment to help defend reproductive rights?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53851977/376686894/360385765?refcode=email_110222_fwdabortion_allactive&amount=5&amounts=5,15,25,50,100&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NmI1YTA1OS05ZjVhLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DKp_-FFSp3doN2gHaw1rVlE6wCuKrK6La0VQx47-Zs4=)** You probably know a grandparent, aunt, parent, sibling, or even yourself who marched for the right to choose fifty years ago, before _Roe v. Wade_ became the law of the land. I’ve met people who marched back then — people who are furious and tired that they have to do this all over again for something they thought was set in stone — a right that we all thought would be protected forever. **I want you to know that I’m furious too. That I will not ever back down from protecting the right to choose in Pennsylvania — from protecting women’s lives.** Due to the Supreme Court’s decision, each and every state will decide whether the women who reside there can have an abortion. **So with a Republican Legislature that’s tried time and time again to restrict abortion access (even through a constitutional amendment), we can be certain they’ll send a bill severely limiting abortion access in Pennsylvania to the desk of the next Governor.** **[Know this: abortion remains legal in Pennsylvania — and will remain legal if I’m elected Governor. Can you donate $5 or whatever you can today to elect the only Governor candidate who will protect the right to choose?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53851978/376686895/360385765?refcode=email_110222_fwdabortion_allactive&amount=5&amounts=5,15,25,50,100&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NmI1YTA1OS05ZjVhLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DKp_-FFSp3doN2gHaw1rVlE6wCuKrK6La0VQx47-Zs4=)** These past few weeks have been tough — but I know that we have the voice, the strength, and the determination to keep abortion access legal in Pennsylvania. It was Ben Franklin who, when asked what form of government the constitutional convention had produced, said: “A republic, if you can keep it.”
Donald Trump’s election sealed the deal for me to retire after nearly 4 decades in the U.S. Navy. Having been in uniform for every President since Jimmy Carter, I showed my respect for Mr. Trump with my feet. I was done. It was apparent that the next four years would not go well.
Unfortunately, putting himself before his country culminated when Trump and his fellow Republicans planned, cajoled accomplices, then launched a domestic insurrection on the U.S. Capitol. Five lives were lost, and the nation’s innocence, as well. And it ain’t over.
January 6th set a precedent that leadership in a political party will condone political violence. **To this day, GOP members who continue to perpetuate the Big Lie are a direct threat to our democracy.** My opponent, Senator Chuck Grassley, who voted against Trump’s impeachment and tried to block a bipartisan commission from investigating the attack, still has yet to come clean.
The Republican party needs to cull its ranks of the active insurrectionists. Every single person involved in the January 6 attack needs to be held accountable for their actions, including sitting members of Congress who participated in the planning and execution of the insurrection.
**I’m running for the U.S. Senate against Senator Chuck Grassley because I place nation over baseless insurrection. It is a decision not entirely unlike the time of Lincoln. One does not serve the nation in military service to watch idly while it is dismembered by the likes of Donald Trump and his accomplices, to include Chuck Grassley.**
Chuck Grassley is blanketing the state with TV ads attacking me. Mitch McConnell and his Super PACs are spending boatloads more. I am the ultimate “hard target” for the Republicans, but to get elected, **I need your help now if we're going to turn out the vote and win. I’m not taking money from corporate PACs – instead, I’m relying entirely on grassroots donors _like you_.**

6. If Marco loses, we will not be able to take back the Senate and get our country back.

Before I got into politics, I thought you had to write big checks to make a difference. But now, let me tell you, any dollar can make a difference in a race like this that's tied. If you're staying on the sidelines because you think you don't matter, that's just not true!

You have the power to decide what happens next. _You have two choices:_
1. Accept that the Democrats have won, and we can't get our country back on track.
2. [**We can work together to save our country and take back control from the Democrats. **](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61780270:6TqQSsGNK:m:1:3366222934:2F4FAB8E05C89D812EF5B5C8D60E0CA4:r)

******[JOIN THE TEAM THAT SAVES AMERICA >>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61780270:6TqQSsGNK:m:1:3366222934:2F4FAB8E05C89D812EF5B5C8D60E0CA4:r)******

If you don't donate because you think it doesn't matter, I really hope you reconsider. If you can't donate because you can't afford to, know that I understand, and I appreciate you taking the time to read this.

I appreciate you,
Dr. Ben Carson

name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: My story in pictures
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
| |
---
| | | Peter,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I decided to run for U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61780276:6zUkSsGgN:m:1:3367311000:264330C289665130A7475DDFFB51E89F:r "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61780276:6zUkSsGgN:m:1:3367311000:264330C289665130A7475DDFFB51E89F:r "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61780276:6zUkSsGgN:m:1:3367311000:264330C289665130A7475DDFFB51E89F:r "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61780276:6zUkSsGgN:m:1:3367311000:264330C289665130A7475DDFFB51E89F:r "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61780276:6zUkSsGgN:m:1:3367311000:264330C289665130A7475DDFFB51E89F:r "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and
every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61780276:6zUkSsGgN:m:1:3367311000:264330C289665130A7475DDFFB51E89F:r "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind
active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61780276:6zUkSsGgN:m:1:3367311000:264330C289665130A7475DDFFB51E89F:r "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an
advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61780276:6zUkSsGgN:m:1:3367311000:264330C289665130A7475DDFFB51E89F:r "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family has decided to take on a new challenge. I made the choice to run for U.S. Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61780276:6zUkSsGgN:m:1:3367311000:264330C289665130A7475DDFFB51E89F:r "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique
problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, Peter. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61780276:6zUkSsGgN:m:1:3367311000:264330C289665130A7475DDFFB51E89F:r "So please, can you chip in just a
few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. ")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61780276:6zUkSsGgN:m:1:3367311000:264330C289665130A7475DDFFB51E89F:r "KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61780276:6zUkSsGgN:m:1:3367311000:264330C289665130A7475DDFFB51E89F:r "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---

---
Peter,

Last week former President Obama was in Atlanta to campaign for Raphael Warnock and Stacey Abrams.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61780718:65UHqsGNe:m:1:3370555685:19EF31E81165FC9F5012E81B9D261675:r)
Democrats know that Georgia is KEY to the Senate majority, so they are using all their big names to make a last-minute pitch for the struggling campaigns of Warnock and Abrams.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61780718:65UHqsGNe:m:1:3370555685:19EF31E81165FC9F5012E81B9D261675:r)
They saw how Senator Warnock performed at our debate. They can't believe after spending $60 million to attack me, this race is still tied. And we know they're desperate because we heard it directly from Chuck Schumer and Joe Biden this week during their hot mic moment. **That's why Democrats sounded the alarm and asked President Obama to campaign in Georgia.**

_**What did President Obama have to say about me?**_ He called me a celebrity who wants to be a politician. He got that one wrong. I'm not a celebrity or your typical politician; _I'm a warrior for God._

He got something else wrong, too. He encouraged us to vote for Joe Biden two years ago, didn't he? We've all seen how that's worked out for us - record inflation, open borders, more crime, and less freedom.

**With his poor track record of losing Georgia twice and encouraging us to support Joe Biden, I think President Obama probably needs to sit this one out.**

But here's the thing, Peter. President Obama's visit to Georgia will gin up Democrats and help Senator Warnock raise millions. The moment he got off the stage, my opponent was begging supporters for money.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61780718:65UHqsGNe:m:1:3370555685:19EF31E81165FC9F5012E81B9D261675:r)
**[I need your help. We're being outraised by millions, and the gap is growing with President Obama's visit. Will you chip in $5, $10, or even $34 today?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61780718:65UHqsGNe:m:1:3370555685:19EF31E81165FC9F5012E81B9D261675:r)**

Thanks for standing with me in these final days.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61780718:65UHqsGNe:m:1:3370555685:19EF31E81165FC9F5012E81B9D261675:r)

Herschel Walker

name: Reclaiming American Freedom
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. This sponsored message from Reclaiming American Freedom is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=ff65b1f068884b85b28c18f6ed92532f&_e=M-SFYjJ9gyRtXTsGl8iT3SGKixixQvauugql70fGp1nQc7x7WFgoVCB56CHa1ohXJ9iRk9KQqbnq2MN72bErT_XOpjDN3TFoCU6zcPb9a__TacE4dguwqMwHd5onVmcdZe3CCxwyvvZw0ojAiYUCoiNqSb98CduyfWHC4gg2dfyPKGTFujSwdU-2AvTHVRKa13P9g9Jms8byAmNVowmcT8hyYQsU7-HIgk1oSLnspYpcNQ3a0-mZlhXfy5TYgUWIqHvmKQYQ2aWEKqygOaYElhxHsJ6167GHxe0jR5ZXIBc_SvhwQtdPYfjgG47kg0V45d0twxLAxrdIMIoR8Bc-i-TSw4v2of43BjWRGmr4qQdeeClSD8kz54APfNXgFGFBp0TGVab-N8G1M8Q8Xxmf2Q%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=ff65b1f068884b85b28c18f6ed92532f&_e=M-SFYjJ9gyRtXTsGl8iT3SGKixixQvauugql70fGp1nQc7x7WFgoVCB56CHa1ohXJ9iRk9KQqbnq2MN72bErT_XOpjDN3TFoCU6zcPb9a__TacE4dguwqMwHd5onVmcdZe3CCxwyvvZw0ojAiYUCoiNqSb98CduyfWHC4gg2dfyPKGTFujSwdU-2AvTHVRKa13P9g9Jms8byAmNVowmcT8hyYQsU7-HIgk1oSLnspYpHozLMa9p5B1flzmkOweoZ5GT0SVgtyw_DyHe_DVM369mczDcv77sjJ86W80S6NYy7cfXojKQX4wu6hyPGYCWxnFAdC82hMZBkRoCSMNukADJ5gQ0BgejoOGlZVeoydgADT63UQ17xjAXngkmkmUokh8sP4Rp8Q7AIzeDplWIr3g%3D%3D)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=ff65b1f068884b85b28c18f6ed92532f&_e=M-SFYjJ9gyRtXTsGl8iT3SGKixixQvauugql70fGp1nQc7x7WFgoVCB56CHa1ohXJ9iRk9KQqbnq2MN72bErT_XOpjDN3TFoCU6zcPb9a__TacE4dguwqMwHd5onVmcdZe3CCxwyvvZw0ojAiYUCoiNqSb98CduyfWHC4gg2dfyPKGTFujSwdU-2AvTHVRKa13P9g9Jms8byAmNVowmcT8hyYQsU7-HIgk1oSLnspYp-tDQuR_dJMIlv4JnOAEmhgIVgigfGN07ciX8dVKUUSMScbn4zps4DhIphOAGa1O8rq_kV_hAryN-ehUGtO-VVDGn2TiFL-OmgFaDZiue-vbp1YzfQU0THkZThpnMM7UuPP6OSKnGMKQ6qEktRNqYMSBtJeI7dm9MsuoqxAk8-hQ%3D%3D)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

Hello,
When Donald Trump was elected, I submitted my request to retire from the U.S. Navy after nearly 4 decades of military service. I never expected I’d one day run for office, but I felt called to continue to serve in whatever way was most meaningful.
People told me to prepare myself – to prepare my family – for what lay ahead. They warned me of the nasty attacks, that politics is a ‘blood sport.’ **I never thought a Super PAC would run over a million dollars in TV ads attacking me for serving in the U.S. Navy, but that’s exactly what happened.**
They tried to say that because my military service took me and my family from state-to-state, from country-to-country, that I somehow wasn’t an Iowan anymore. They pretended my upbringing in rural, northwest Iowa never happened. They ignored the sacrifices that my wife, my kids, and my family made in my service.

THEN: We're going to blow up the drug tunnels... and I don't care if there's a Narco-Terrorist in there when we do it. And when we see those cartel drones flying across the border, we're gonna shoot them down. And FINALLY, this is a no-brainer: We're going to FINISH THE WALL. That's only the beginning of what I will accomplish. But there's no way we can succeed with even one of those things if I do not secure a victory this November. That's why I'm reaching out to you today. My name is Kari Lake and I need your support now to become the next Governor of Arizona. | | Peter, this race is one of the most important fights in the entire country. It's our chance to prove to corporate media that we are stronger than the lies. It's our chance to prove to the establishment elite that the NEW RIGHT is here to stay. And it's our chance to SECURE OUR BORDER, defend our small businesses, defeat inflation, end leftist indoctrination and get our nation back on track. Though the results took longer than they should have, Arizonans who have been forgotten by the establishment already delivered a POLITICAL EARTHQUAKE in the GOP primary. We won every single county in Arizona! Now, all eyes are on us... And we need to stay strong... Will you chip in now to keep up the momentum? | | | | I know that Arizona desperately needs visionary leadership to address the serious problems we face. Our economy is in shambles as inflation increases every single day. Our education system has been infiltrated by radicals forcing liberal indoctrination on our children. Our communities face rising crime rates as illegal immigration threatens our security. Our election integrity is in danger as corrupt courts and liberal media continue to interfere in our Democracy. It's clear that the status quo, establishment rule isn't working for us. I will fight to secure our elections, crack down on crime, and defend our children and our Constitution because I know there's no time to waste. We need transformative leadership to get things done. I'm telling you right now that is exactly the kind of leader I am - but you don't need to take my word for it._You can take it from President Trump. | | He endorsed me for Governor in the early days of a crowded Republican primary and stands with me now as we aim to defeat my Democrat opponent. Will you join him and support my campaign today so we can save this country together? | | | | I'm so proud to have the support of the President - because I'm a huge supporter of his! President Trump taught us in the "NEW RIGHT" how to fight. When he came on the scene, I started taking notes. He gave us the game plan and showed us how to stand up to put America first. The status quo be damned! That's why I go after the fake news and call out the establishment politicians who have failed us so dramatically. And trust me, I will continue to do so. Because I know we're all tired of losing - and even more than that - we're tired of the lies!**** My opponent is part of that weak, dying establishment. She's supported by the corporate media and the ruling elite, and she has proven time and time again that she's loyal to the failing status quo. But we sent a message on August 2nd and we have to send the same message in November: we are sick and tired of the political elite. We've seen what they have to offer. And with Joe Biden's reckless agenda threatening everything we believe in, we just can't afford to be represented by those who don't know how to fight for the people. I know how important it is to fight. I'm up for it. I'm ready. I just need your support now to make sure I have the chance. Please, chip in whatever you can now: Thank you in advance for your contribution. # National Defense Political Action Committee Endorsement
---
|
---
| | |
---|---
|
Today, Erik Aadland, CD7 Republican candidate for Congress, announces a formal endorsement from the National Defense Political Action Committee.

The National Defense Political Action Committee (NDPAC) is dedicated to supporting the election of balanced-budget-committed Military Veterans to the U. S. Congress. NDPAC supports a strong American national security public policy through a non-partisan open political action committee. NDPAC has been active for more than twenty years and has a solid record of supporting winning candidates for elected office.
---
| In a statement sent to Erik Aadland's campaign, Captain Bob Carey, U.S. Navy (Retired), Chairman of NDPAC, said:
"Erik Aadland's exemplary record of leadership in both the military and private sector make him the best choice to represent Colorado's 7th Congressional District. His service to our country has afforded him a heart for servant leadership and a clear-headed approach to both policy and constituent services.
We are proud to join the ranks of former Secretary of the Interior and retired Navy SEAL Ryan Zinke, Rep. Brian Mast (R-FL), Rep. Don Bacon (R-NE), Rep. Jack Bergman (R-MI), Rep. Jim Banks (R-IN), SAMPAC, the Guardian Fund, and the Combat Veterans for Congress PAC. Colorado needs his leadership and experience.
Erik's deep knowledge of group and individual psychology gives him a unique perspective on how lost and broken American society is becoming. Radical government policies hurt everyday Coloradans and he knows the commonsense policies needed to restore Constitutional balance and bring effective change for all of Colorado's citizens."
---
| |
---
---
|
# Erik's Remarks
---
| |
---
|
---
| "I am honored and humbled to receive the endorsement of National Defense PAC in my candidacy for Congress. When I served our country in the Army, I risked my life to defend our Constitution and saw its enemies face to face. I will bring the same courage to bear on my service in Congress. I understand the crises facing America and I am ready to take action to remedy them. I will advocate for sensible and sustainable policies that will curb inflation, cultivate economic opportunity, re-prioritize national security and military readiness, ensure energy independence, and bolster public safety. I feel privileged to be standing alongside so many incredible veteran candidates running for office this fall. Together, we will uphold the U.S. Constitution and restore this country's greatness "

disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY SHAPIRO FOR PENNSYLVANIA
body:
Mastriano argued in his master’s thesis against civilian control of our military – implying that the armed forces should be running the nation.

Hey Derek, you’ve heard about how Doug Mastriano attended the insurrection, doesn’t believe same-sex couples should exist, and wants to ban all abortion with zero exceptions. **But he’s even more dangerous than that.** Mastriano argued in his master’s thesis against civilian control of our military – implying that the armed forces should be running the nation. He even went on to also disparage the LGBTQ+ community and assert that non-Christian religions and political correctness would lead to a takeover by a left-wing dictator. This is nothing short of dangerous. And this game is going to come down to the final drive. = Thank you, Chris Deluzio On Tues, November 1, 2022, Franco Harris wrote: Hi there: With only a few days left before Election Day, I wanted to tell you why I’m supporting Chris Deluzio for Congress in Pennsylvania’s 17th District. = I know what it takes to win a tough fight: Hard work, determination, and commitment. Those are the qualities that drove me to become a four-time Super Bowl champion for the Steelers, and those are the qualities that will make Chris Deluzio an excellent Member of Congress representing us. But unlike my days with the Steelers, there’s much more at stake in this election than just a Super Bowl ring. Our democracy is being threatened. Women’s reproductive rights and the voting rights of millions of Americans are being taken away. The powerful gun lobby is putting automatic assault weapons on our streets and in our schools. Millions of seniors struggle to pay for prescription drugs while Big Pharma is making record profits. And our LGBTQ+ friends and neighbors live in fear over their right to marry the ones they love. So with so much at stake, I’m asking everyone to get in the game and vote for Chris Deluzio! = | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | = = | = = | = = There are less than two weeks until the election. This is the fourth quarter and the game is on the line, and it’s win or lose. Let’s get out there and elect Chris Deluzio for Congress! Thank you, and “Here We Go, Chris!” Franco Harris | Chris Deluzio is a voting rights lawyer and Iraq war veteran running for Congress in Pennsylvania's 17th District. He'll be a champion for our unions, fight to guarantee good healthcare for every American, take on corporate power, and advocate for bold action to protect and strengthen our democracy. This is one of the most competitive districts in the country, and Democrats have to hold it in order to keep their House majority in 2022. = | = | Paid for by Chris Deluzio for Congress Chris Deluzio for Congress PO Box 16210 Pittsburgh, PA 15242 United States Chris Deluzio is a United States Veteran. clean_body: We couldn't have reached this point without you. Thank you for your support. Peter, It's the final week of this election. Our team is working non-stop, but there's one thing I wanted to be sure to do personally: I want to say thank you. Democrats are closer than ever to winning a 52 seat majority in the Senate thanks to your support. Your investments helped us support underdog challengers and incumbents who have built up stronger campaigns as a result. You believed we could win even when pundits predicted a red wave. Now, I need to ask you for one more favor. Democrats in Pennsylvania and across the Nation need your help to get out the vote in these final days of the election. State parties and local campaigns are organizing events everywhere. Even if you can't find a local event, you can find ways to help out online. Your neighbors need to hear why you're voting and how they can do their civic duty as well. As you , I hope you'll also take a moment to pat yourself on the back for helping take us this far. I'm so grateful. Thank you for your continued support, Bob Casey P.S. name: Reagan Dunn
subject: An opportunity for needed change
disclaimer_text: Paid for by People
body:
Years of one-party rule in Olympia have resulted in special
interest-driven policies and deeply ideological schemes that fail
to meet the needs of everyday working families.

Team -

I'm proud to endorse and support
Kyle Lyebyedyev for State Representative.

If the last few years have taught
us anything, it's that our state government is not working for
us. Years of one-party rule in Olympia have resulted in special
interest-driven policies and deeply ideological schemes that fail
to meet the needs of everyday working families.

Democrats' persistent tax and fee
increases are driving up the cost of living and burdening
families. Rather than work within generous budgets boosted by
record-breaking revenues, Democrats have spent recklessly to
reward special interest supporters. And it's you and I who pick
up the tab.

Every day we see the impact of
the deeply flawed anti-law enforcement ideology championed by
Democrats. Crime is skyrocketing in our communities, and our
police are understaffed and overwhelmed. Democrats' policies have
handcuffed our police and emboldened criminals to break the law,
disproportionately impacting the most vulnerable community
members.

We need a change.

For the first time since 1998,
Republicans have a chance at gaining a majority in the state
House of Representatives. Whether or not we have leaders willing
to fight for lower taxes and public safety depends on competitive
races like Republican Kyle Lyebyedyev in the 47th Legislative
District.

Kyle is a first-generation
immigrant from Ukraine. He's worked hard to achieve the American
Dream - and I trust that he will work just as hard to serve you
in the State House.

Kyle is running because he
believes in commonsense principles like families knowing how to
spend their money better than the government and the need to
maintain and preserve the rule of law. His race is competitive,
and he needs your help during the final week leading up to
Election Day.

A contribution of $100, $75, or
even just $25 ensures he has the resources to reach undecided
voters in the next few days. Will you help?

Many voters have already
submitted their ballots - those who haven't are more likely to be
undecided swing voters. It's crucial that Kyle's team has the
resources they need to reach these voters.

I hope that you will join me in
helping get Kyle over the finish line.

Thank you,

Reagan Dunn
King County Councilmember

for Kyle (R)

Covington, WA 98042

---
| | | Peter, my name is Adam Laxalt. You may have never heard of me, so I wanted to take a moment to tell you a bit about why I'm running for U.S. Senate in Nevada.

I was born in Reno, Nevada and raised by a single mother. Growing up, it was just me and my mom. I have always aspired to be as much of a leader as she was.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61780464:J5lVOsG4N:m:1:3373497171:822E1936272FB8A8E1FFFEB8DFC09614:r "Adam 1")
---

I know that real leadership means standing up for what you believe in and standing up for people everywhere. But I was headed down the wrong path in life.

As a teenager, I suffered from addiction. But the people who loved me got me help. I turned my life around, and that taught me helping others gives life meaning. That's why I volunteered to serve in the Navy after 9/11 and volunteered to serve in the Iraq War.

---
| | | [SUPPORT ADAM LAXALT](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61780464:J5lVOsG4N:m:1:3373497171:822E1936272FB8A8E1FFFEB8DFC09614:r "SUPPORT ADAM LAXALT")
---

Serving our country as a Navy Officer in Iraq was an honor.

While I was serving, my unit was in charge of over 20,000 detainees to keep American troops safe. This was one of the most challenging experiences of my life, but also the most rewarding.

_Knowing that I was on the front lines of protecting the country I love so dearly is something that I will continue to cherish for the rest of my life. _

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61780464:J5lVOsG4N:m:1:3373497171:822E1936272FB8A8E1FFFEB8DFC09614:r "Adam 2")

After returning from Iraq, I felt the call to serve my state again and went on to be Nevada's Attorney General and top law enforcement officer. I fought hard to serve the people of Nevada, where I fought against President Obama by suing over federal overreach. I fought for the Constitution.

Now I'm taking on a huge challenge for our country: running for U.S. Senate.

---

My race is **officially the #1 race in the country** , and all eyes are on me. The Democrats have already raised 76 MILLION to destroy my campaign.

Unlike my opponent, I rely on grassroots supporters like you to keep my campaign running.

I know I will be great leader for the people of Nevada, and for the people of America.

Adam Laxalt

name: John Fries
subject: taking a step back from the deadlines and horse-race politics
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Trudy Busch Valentine for Senate
body:
Trudy'll face whatever the future holds with tenderness, determination, and grit.
| | |
---
Peter, do you have a moment? I know your inbox is likely bombarded with urgent fundraising requests right now, **but I want to take a step back from the deadlines and the horse-race politics to tell you why my wife, Trudy, is the leader Missouri deserves.**
**You see, Trudy is a rock – she's led her family through immense loss and pain that cuts unimaginably deep.** She became a single mom when her first husband passed away from cancer at just 49, leaving her to raise six grief-stricken children by herself. During that moment of tragedy and uncertainty, Trudy stood steady for her kids and helped them heal.
When I see Trudy, I think of the empathy, the steadfastness, and the warmth she has brought into my life and into our family's life. She shares this love and compassion with our whole family, with her patients, and with her community.**And as division and partisanship bring so much hatred to our state and nation, Missouri needs her leadership in the U.S. Senate, too.**
I promise you that Trudy will fight for your family, listen to your concerns, and put you first, every time. **And when the going gets tough, she won't shirk her duties, make excuses, or hide away. She'll face whatever the future holds with tenderness, determination, and grit. **That's why I am so thrilled to cast my ballot for Trudy in just 6 days.
I believe in Trudy, and you should, too. But unfortunately here's where the deadlines and the politics come into play. **You see, Trudy's far-right opponent is being bankrolled by Mitch McConnell's megadonors _and_ Trump's megadonors.** The only way that she can compete with GOP spending in these final days is with strong grassroots support from folks like you.
**But right now she's still $3,138 away from her next midnight goal – and she just has a few hours left to hit it.[This is a make-or-break moment for her campaign, so please, will you make a grassroots donation before her midnight deadline? Fellow Patriots, The left-wing media is starting to turn on Stacey Abrams and it's absolutely hilarious. Just this week, The Atlantic, which is no friend to the conservative movement, [published a piece](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/434664?id=3894103.650.1.2ae73b28abff1155747d385a2124a625) highlighting "losers" like Stacey Abrams. _"American politics doesn’t have anyone quite like Haru Urara. But it does have Beto O’Rourke and Stacey Abrams. The two Democrats are among the country’s best-known political figures, better known than almost any sitting governor or U.S. senator. And they have become so well known not by winning big elections but by losing them."_ The article discusses Stacey's 2018 loss and subsequent rise in national stardom. Her fundraising prowess and the infrastructure she's created to build support and fund her lifestyle. However, the expose' fails to mention her gaffes on the campaign trail, inability to connect with average voters, and radical agenda that's better suited for California than Georgia. Stacey's a "loser" that the Democrats love because she's their mouthpiece. Even if she loses again on Tuesday, November 8, Stacey Abrams is the best player on their team. In these final days, we are pushing hard to end Stacey Abrams' political career. It's not just about winning at the ballot box.
