| | Folks – I was proud to bring Nancy Pelosi to Novi, Michigan to visit ONE, a fuel cell battery manufacturer that will soon employ over 2,000 people in my state. And because we passed and signed into law the _Inflation Reduction Act_ that also included some of the biggest climate investments in the history of this world, my home state is on stronger footing to usher in electric vehicles and new technologies. None of this would have happened without the leadership of Nancy Pelosi. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53854242/376694861/1575274555?refcode=EM_BS_STE_221102_FR_NancyVisit_A0_na_U1_X1&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODA3NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNDc5NjQ0NC1hZTVhLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pgYe6VBnvAqK9CehwlImYe_189rQvqE2aXbCM_H56fs=) I was there with her in Congress when we passed this landmark legislation and I know what it means for the innovators and job creators back home. A clearer playing field to win the future tax credits that allow business leaders to invest. Our moon shot of the 21st century. Some of you may remember, I flipped a seat in 2018 and held this seat in 2020, becoming the first Democrat to win a second term to the 11th district in 100 years. Novi, Michigan is the home of great schools, fantastic neighborhoods, and companies like ONE. It's also one of the communities that we converted from voting Republican to voting Democratic. We did this by speaking the economic language of the community, like supporting manufacturing, job training, and investing in skills (we have amazing First Robotics teams in West Oakland County). I didn’t just talk about these things as I campaigned – I acted on them as I governed. My first bill was the _Building Blocks of STEM Act_ signed into law before the end of 2019 (my first year in Congress). I worked with manufacturers every day and helped Congress pass a trade deal to increase American production. I also helped author the _Chips and Science Act,_ in addition to getting the infrastructure and climate bill done to take us to the next level. I couldn’t be more excited to bring Speaker Nancy Pelosi to Michigan to show her the legislation in action, what it means to our workforce, and how we are going to continue to utilize our federal authorities to advance the industry of the future and compete with China and others. I wanted to take a minute to peel behind the curtain and show you what's taking place on the ground and why I am optimistic. I also want to ask for your support one more time so we can continue to grow the economy in ways that we see happening in the automotive capital of the world. We will see zero emissions one day soon and it's because of legislation I helped pass into law and because innovation leaders like ONE knew they could succeed in the place I call home. **I want to continue putting Michigan workers and Michigan’s economy first, but I need your help to win my critical election.** [Will you rush $10 to help us win this race on Election Day and continue delivering results for everyday Michiganders?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53854243/376694862/1575274555?refcode=EM_BS_STE_221102_FR_NancyVisit_A0_na_U1_X1&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODA3NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNDc5NjQ0NC1hZTVhLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pgYe6VBnvAqK9CehwlImYe_189rQvqE2aXbCM_H56fs=) _If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:_ | | | [Chip in $10](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53854244/376694863/2012793621?refcode=EM_BS_STE_221102_FR_NancyVisit_A0_na_U1_X1&amount=10&express_lane=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODA3NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNDc5NjQ0NC1hZTVhLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pgYe6VBnvAqK9CehwlImYe_189rQvqE2aXbCM_H56fs=)

clean_body: | = | | Folks – I was proud to bring Nancy Pelosi to Novi, Michigan to visit ONE, a fuel cell battery manufacturer that will soon employ over 2,000 people in my state. And because we passed and signed into law the Inflation Reduction Act that also included some of the biggest climate investments in the history of this world, my home state is on stronger footing to usher in electric vehicles and new technologies. None of this would have happened without the leadership of Nancy Pelosi. = I was there with her in Congress when we passed this landmark legislation and I know what it means for the innovators and job creators back home. A clearer playing field to win the future tax credits that allow business leaders to invest. Our moon shot of the 21st century. Some of you may remember, I flipped a seat in 2018 and held this seat in 2020, becoming the first Democrat to win a second term to the 11th district in 100 years. Novi, Michigan is the home of great schools, fantastic neighborhoods, and companies like ONE. It's also one of the communities that we converted from voting Republican to voting Democratic. We did this by speaking the economic language of the community, like supporting manufacturing, job training, and investing in skills (we have amazing First Robotics teams in West Oakland County). I didn’t just talk about these things as I campaigned – I acted on them as I governed. My first bill was the Building Blocks of STEM Act signed into law before the end of 2019 (my first year in Congress). I worked with manufacturers every day and helped Congress pass a trade deal to increase American production. I also helped author the Chips and Science Act, in addition to getting the infrastructure and climate bill done to take us to the next level. I couldn’t be more excited to bring Speaker Nancy Pelosi to Michigan to show her the legislation in action, what it means to our workforce, and how we are going to continue to utilize our federal authorities to advance the industry of the future and compete with China and others. I wanted to take a minute to peel behind the curtain and show you what's taking place on the ground and why I am optimistic. I also want to ask for your support one more time so we can continue to grow the economy in ways that we see happening in the automotive capital of the world. Wow, friend, last night I had my grassroots rally with President Barack Obama and I am more fired up and inspired to fight than I've ever been. **[Please, will you rush a donation of $5 to join President Obama in powering our movement to protect Nevada's Senate seat and our Democratic majority?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53880378/376795873/-375078852?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2181-bu-nd&recurring=0&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZDIzNmVmZC1kMzVhLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6kg4lq7tFzEeBMlqKRqOMZdXyMrFduZ_dmvLI4bCXZ4=)**

I left the stage feeling so hopeful – listening to Barack Obama speak tends to do that to you. And it's not in vain: We are _so close_ to crossing the finish line and coming out ahead.
But as we were on stage, and as I write to you now, Mitch McConnell is bombarding Nevada's airwaves with ads viciously attacking me –******just as new polling shows me statistically tied with my Trump-backed opponent.**
**That's why my team and I set a goal to raise $500,000 before the end of the rally. name: Ken Burns
subject: I'm Endorsing Maggie
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Maggie for NH |
body:
Our country stands at a crossroads, and it's up to us to decide which direction we’ll take.
| | |
---
Friends –

I've spent more than four decades making films that tell America’s stories, and examining the crises – internal and external – that we have faced as a nation, including threats to our democracy.
From the Civil War to the Great Depression, from the First and Second World Wars to the COVID-19 pandemic, these crises have challenged us to live up to the essential promise of our nation, preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.
Today, challenges to our republic are rampant, the democratic values that make up the very fabric of our nation under assault and at risk of unraveling. It’s never been more important to safeguard our fragile democracy: as Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it."

That’s why I’m reaching out. With a 50-50 split in the Senate, the fate of our Democratic majority—and our very democracy—hinges on what happens in New Hampshire.
Maggie Hassan is a vital voice in the Senate, and we cannot afford to lose her tireless work on behalf of Granite Staters—and in fact all Americans. This November, she's up against a far-right election denier who believes a woman’s most personal decisions about abortion—decisions about her own body—belong in the hands of Republican “gentlemen” lawmakers.
Our country stands at a crossroads, and it's up to us to decide which direction we’ll take. Either we plunge down the path of extremism that Maggie's opponent has taken, or we choose the other way—the higher road—and come together to support leaders like Maggie who will fight to protect our future.
Maggie won her last race by just 1,017 votes. That was one of the closest margins in American history. And Republicans are targeting her race with nearly $60 million in attack ads. With just 6 days left until the election, we need to have the resources necessary to turn out every last vote.
**[So I'm asking you now, friend: will you help meet this moment by pitching in to Maggie Hassan's reelection campaign today?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53859937/376716389/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk2014-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmOTAzMjFkNy1iMzVhLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TQ9QgavHTo3aWmbnbD18egdlU1Iu5fNqiZrixV8BbfQ=)**
With Washington divided, I believe that Maggie is the person we need to help bridge the gulf between the two parties, wider now and more divisive than I have ever seen. It's incumbent on us to redouble our efforts and dig a little deeper to ensure that Maggie has the support she needs to be reelected.
**[Please, join me in supporting Maggie by chipping in what you can. The stakes have never been higher.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53859938/376716390/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk2014-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmOTAzMjFkNy1iMzVhLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TQ9QgavHTo3aWmbnbD18egdlU1Iu5fNqiZrixV8BbfQ=)**
Thank you,
Ken

Dear Person I’m Asking To Contribute To Admiral Mike Franken (To Beat Chuck Grassley [Who He’s Within 3 Points Of]),
I’m no relation to Mike Franken. Also, I’m not an admiral. [**But I’m supporting Mike’s campaign for the U.S. Senate in Iowa against Chuck Grassley.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53882181/376803026/-42398318?refcode=em20221102mid2-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDI4MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NWJkMDMyZC1kODVhLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0RQrUSMX04M1OAFrFQZaqxyvfkyvmq7pP4cTLoAg8qI=)
You might not have heard about this race. That’s because no one really gave Mike a chance. _But I did._ I’ve been supporting him for months. And suddenly, everyone thinks I’m a genius! **Because the latest _Des Moines Register_ poll has Mike within 3 points of Grassley, trailing 46%-43% with likely voters. That’s within the margin of error!**
What did I know that others didn’t? First, Grassley is unpopular with Iowans. Two-thirds think he’s too old (89) to be running for another 6-year term.
Also, some of his old baloney is coming back to haunt him. Remember when he claimed that The Affordable Care Act was going to create _“death panels”_ that would _“pull the plug on grandma?”_
The Affordable Care Act is now deeply popular in Iowa!!
Meanwhile, Iowans have been getting to know Mike Franken. And like what they see!
[**I’m personally asking: Will you give $10 or more now to Mike’s campaign to help him defeat Chuck Grassley this November and protect our Democratic majority in the Senate?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53882183/376803029/-42398318?refcode=em20221102mid2-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDI4MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NWJkMDMyZC1kODVhLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0RQrUSMX04M1OAFrFQZaqxyvfkyvmq7pP4cTLoAg8qI=)
Mike was born and raised in Lebanon, Iowa – which I’ve never been to. He’s a three-star admiral who served over 36 years in the Navy. He commanded a destroyer and participated in nine post-9/11 operations. And now he wants to serve Iowa in US Senate.
In late 2002, as a young lieutenant, Mike Franken was tasked by the White House to be part of a Pentagon group to plan the invasion of Iraq. Mike was the task force’s junior member, full of generals and career politicians. When the vote came, they were presented with three invasion plans. Mike was the only member of the task force to vote for a fourth option: **DON’T INVADE!**
We need more people in the Senate with the courage and integrity of a Mike Franken. Well, not “a Mike Franken.” **Mike Franken.**
**While everyone (including me) has been looking at Nevada, Wisconsin, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Georgia, and Arizona, I’ve been the only one screaming about Iowa. I know Chuck Grassley. Chuck Grassley was a colleague of mine. Chuck Grassley is too old! And Iowans know it!**
[**Please, give $10 or more right now to Admiral Mike Franken’s campaign and help him finally defeat Chuck Grassley and turn Iowa blue.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53882189/376803037/-42398318?refcode=em20221102mid2-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDI4MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NWJkMDMyZC1kODVhLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0RQrUSMX04M1OAFrFQZaqxyvfkyvmq7pP4cTLoAg8qI=)

name: Office of U.S. Senator Raphael Warnock
subject: Focused on Fighting Inflation & Lowering Costs for Hardworking Georgians
body:
|
---
Hi Neighbor, I talk to Georgians in every corner of the state who are struggling with rising costs at the gas pump, the cash register, and the pharmacy counter. That's why I've focused on doing everything in my power to lower everyday costs for Georgians, and to combat rising costs by fighting against greedy corporations, fixing supply chain issues, and cutting taxes for hardworking Georgia families. **LOWERING HEALTHCARE COSTS FOR GEORGIANS** I'm proud to have delivered concrete results that will save Georgians money on their healthcare expenses, especially our seniors-many who live on a fixed income.
* I was proud to pass the _Inflation Reduction Act_ , which includes provisions I championed to **limit prescription drug costs for seniors to $2,000 a year** and **cap insulin costs at $35 a month for Medicare patients**.

* Additionally, the law **makes covered vaccines free for seniors,** and **_finally_****allows Medicare to directly negotiate with drug companies to lower prices. **

Lastly, the law **helps keep healthcare costs for millions of Georgians and Americans low by extending premium subsidies to help folks pay for health insurance on the Affordable Care Act marketplace**. **FIGHTING TO LOWER HIGH COSTS OF GAS & EVERYDAY GOODS** Few issues have been tougher on Georgia families than high gas prices, making it more expensive for Georgians to go to work or school or manage a family. That's why I've been laser-focused on holding big oil and gas corporations accountable for taking advantage of global events to hike gas prices. And while gas prices have come down some, as your Senator, I won't stop fighting to lessen the pain at the pump too many Georgians are facing.
* That's why **I introduced legislation to tax oil and gas companies ' excess profits, incentivizing them to give that money back to working people**.

* **I also introduced a bill to waive the federal gas tax through the end of the year** and put dollars back in the pockets of Georgia drivers-an idea that Georgia state leaders decided to put into practice.

That's not all: I've also been busy working to pass legislation to lower the cost of other everyday goods.
* **I introduced a bill that would save Georgians money on essential items like groceries, school supplies, diapers, and more** by allowing states to use relief dollars to fund a sales tax holiday.

* **I 've championed new legislation that would save Georgians money on their rent **by providing a tax cut to families whose rent exceeds 30% of their income.

**EASING SUPPLY CHAIN TENSIONS & FIGHTING PRICE-GOUGING FROM GREEDY CORPORATIONS ** Global supply chain issues have significantly driven up the costs of everyday goods, and I have a strong track record in the Senate of working to address supply chain issues and their impact in Georgia.
* When as many as 30 vessels were backed up at the Port of Savannah, **I pressured the Biden Administration to release $8 million in federal funding to get the number of ships stationed at the port down to ****_zero_** _, _easing supply chain issues across the state.

At the same time, while many companies have been making record profits, Georgians have been paying record prices. I'm committed to fighting apparent price gouging from wealthy special interests who are padding their bottom line on the backs of Georgians.
* I **successfully pushed the Biden Administration to investigate the exploitative practices of international shipping companies** that have raised prices in the last two years, increasing their profits by over 2,000%.

* I also **led the effort to get legislation signed into law that helps prevent shipping carriers from price gouging.**

And I plan to **keep going after big banks and financial institutions for nickel and diming Georgians** by pushing them to eliminate their overdraft fees and other predatory junk fees. As a voice for our state in the Senate, I'll never stop fighting in Washington to bring down inflation, save Georgians money, and lower everyday costs for hardworking Georgia families. Until next time, neighbors, keep the faith, and keep looking up.
U.S. Senator Reverend Raphael Warnock

| This is official correspondence from the Office of Senator Reverend Raphael Warnock. I also led the effort to get legislation signed into law that helps prevent shipping carriers from price gouging. And I plan to keep going after big banks and financial institutions for nickel and diming Georgians by pushing them to eliminate their overdraft fees and other predatory junk fees. As a voice for our state in the Senate, I'll never stop fighting in Washington to bring down inflation, save Georgians money, and lower everyday costs for hardworking Georgia families. Until next time, neighbors, keep the faith, and keep looking up. U.S. Senator Reverend Raphael Warnock | This is official correspondence from the Office of Senator Reverend Raphael Warnock. | _Called "I’ll Always Do What’s Right," the ad talks about inflation, fuel and food prices and leadership_
BRISTOL -- Thelander for Congress today released a new radio ad to run on multiple stations across the 1st Congressional District, including WFNK-FM, WPOR-FM, WTHT-FM, WBLM-FM, WYNZ-FM, WEBB-FM, WQSS-FM, WMCM-FM, WQSS-FM, WKSQ-FM, WBFB.

The spot highlights Thelander's bio and voter concerns about inflation, rising food and fuel prices, Chellie Pingree’s lackluster career in Congress and his ability to reach across the aisle for common sense solutions that actually help Maine families.

Thelander continues to outraise Pingree among individual, Maine-based donations, and has outcampaigned her throughout the race. As Maine Republican Party Executive Director Jason Savage observed recently, “Ed has met more voters, shaken more hands and listened to more people in his fourteen months on the campaign trail than Pingree has in her entire fourteen years in Congress.”

To hear the ad, click here: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5aeFuVhcIVc](https://thelanderforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=035bf0620f01206429344ca39&id=75c94a8e99&e=f8a0a76a2b)

Ad script below:

“I'm Ed Thelander, candidate for Congress.
My wife, Liliana and I have three kids and live in Bristol.
I'm a retired Navy SEAL, a volunteer firefighter, and a reserve deputy sheriff.
We're doing this because Chellie Pingree has failed Maine people, and we all deserve better.
14 years in Congress, and she's never sponsored a bill that passed.
Instead, she gives her vote to her party for bills that drive up food and energy costs.
Recently, Pingree signed a letter along with AOC and the squad that embarrassed the nation and had to be immediately retracted and apologized for.
We all deserve a different kind of leader.
You don't walk the party line and neither will I.
Instead, I'll always do what's right for the community, for Maine.
We need somebody who will show up and work hard to lower inflation gas prices and bring down taxes so that Maine families can get the relief they need.
I'm Ed Thelander, I'm asking for your vote on November 8th.
I approve this message.”

My name is Kari Lake and I need your support now to become the next Governor of Arizona. | | Peter, this race is one of the most important fights in the entire country. It's our chance to prove to corporate media that we are stronger than the lies. It's our chance to prove to the establishment elite that the NEW RIGHT is here to stay. And it's our chance to SECURE OUR BORDER, defend our small businesses, defeat inflation, end leftist indoctrination and get our nation back on track. Though the results took longer than they should have, Arizonans who have been forgotten by the establishment already delivered a POLITICAL EARTHQUAKE in the GOP primary. We won every single county in Arizona! Now, all eyes are on us... And we need to stay strong... Will you chip in now to keep up the momentum? | | | | I know that Arizona desperately needs visionary leadership to address the serious problems we face. Our economy is in shambles as inflation increases every single day. Our education system has been infiltrated by radicals forcing liberal indoctrination on our children. Our communities face rising crime rates as illegal immigration threatens our security. Our election integrity is in danger as corrupt courts and liberal media continue to interfere in our Democracy. It's clear that the status quo, establishment rule isn't working for us. I will fight to secure our elections, crack down on crime, and defend our children and our Constitution because I know there's no time to waste. We need transformative leadership to get things done. I'm telling you right now that is exactly the kind of leader I am - but you don't need to take my word for it._You can take it from President Trump. | | He endorsed me for Governor in the early days of a crowded Republican primary and stands with me now as we aim to defeat my Democrat opponent. Will you join him and support my campaign today so we can save this country together? | | | | I'm so proud to have the support of the President - because I'm a huge supporter of his! President Trump taught us in the "NEW RIGHT" how to fight. When he came on the scene, I started taking notes. He gave us the game plan and showed us how to stand up to put America first. The status quo be damned! That's why I go after the fake news and call out the establishment politicians who have failed us so dramatically. And trust me, I will continue to do so. Because I know we're all tired of losing - and even more than that - we're tired of the lies!**** My opponent is part of that weak, dying establishment. She's supported by the corporate media and the ruling elite, and she has proven time and time again that she's loyal to the failing status quo. But we sent a message on August 2nd and we have to send the same message in November: we are sick and tired of the political elite. We've seen what they have to offer. And with Joe Biden's reckless agenda threatening everything we believe in, we just can't afford to be represented by those who don't know how to fight for the people. I know how important it is to fight. I'm up for it. I'm ready. I just need your support now to make sure I have the chance. Please, chip in whatever you can now: Thank you in advance for your contribution. As a proud Democrat and motivated citizen, I'm lending my full support to Senator Maggie Hassan.
New Hampshire has a clear choice between Maggie Hassan, a qualified and dedicated public servant, and Don Bolduc, a far-right extremist with no respect for women’s rights who will vigorously pursue his own anti-choice agenda.

Maggie is committed to working across the aisle to deliver on the issues that matter most to Americans. Issues like lowering prescription drug costs, taking on corporate special interests, and supporting small businesses.

And now, Val Demings is running for Senate in a race that's a top pickup opportunity for Democrats. She's our best chance to expand our Senate majority, abolish the filibuster and finally pass lifesaving gun safety legislation – like universal background checks and a ban on high-capacity magazines.

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Greater Georgia Action, Inc
body:
| | | | |
---
| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 2
GREATER GEORGIA RELEASES EARLY VOTING ANALYSIS FOR ONE WEEK TO ELECTION DAY
(ATLANTA) - Today, Greater Georgia released an analysis of early and absentee voter turnout for the 2022 midterm general election running Monday, October 17th through Tuesday, November 1st. Compared to the same time period for the 2018 midterm general election, total turnout increased by 36%. With one week until election day, over 1.9 million Georgians cast their ballots by absentee voting or through early in-person voting.
See Greater Georgia analysis on early and absentee voting one week out from Election Day compared to the same time period in the 2018 midterm general election below:
Total Turnout In total, 1,937,462 voters have cast their ballots so far in this year's general election - including 1,751,307 early voters and 186,155 absentee voters. This represents a 36% increase over 2018, when 1,426,079 voters had cast their ballots in total.
Early In-Person Voting 1,751,307 Georgians have voted early so far this year, representing a 39% increase over 2018, when 1,259,763 voters had voted early in-person.
Absentee Voting 186,155 voters have returned their absentee ballots so far this year, representing a 28% increase over 2018, when 145,010 voters had voted absentee. About 66% of all requested absentee ballots have been returned.
Disenfranchised Voters Of the 339,000 conservative voters who voted in the November 2020 general election but did not vote in the January 2021 runoff election, 78,466 have so far voted in the 2022 midterm general election.
First Time Voters 28,453 voters who have voted so far this year are first-time voters.
Voters by Gender While still the majority, women are voting at a slightly lower rate than they did in 2018. So far, 44.8% of voters are male and 55.2% are female, compared to 2018 when 44% of voters were male and 56% were female.
Compared to 2018, the participation rate of men increased by 41% and the participation rate of women increased by 36%.
Voters by Race While still the majority, White voters make up a slightly smaller share of the vote than they did in 2018 - while the Black vote share remains unchanged, and the Asian and Hispanic vote shares have grown. So far, 63.2% of voters are White, 30.9% are Black, 2.3% are Asian, and 2% are Hispanic. In 2018, 64.3% of voters where White, 31% were Black, 1.9% were Asian, and 1.8% were Hispanic.
Compared to 2018, the participation rate of White voters has increased by 36%, Black by 38%, Asian by 69%, and Hispanic by 54%.

# I got the _real_ scoop from an insider...
We hear so many rumors, but it's hard to know what's true in the zoo.

While campaigning for Secretary of State I had the privilege of meeting & working with Garrett Ziegler. At the ripe old age of _25_ , Garrett worked in the West Wing for 45!!

I'm fairly certain that Garrett is a literal genius. He's a VERY interesting, thoughtful young man who impressed my socks off!

I flew Garrett out to California so we could film a conversation. I wanted to share him with _you_ so you too could get the inside scoop on a wide variety of subjects. Because we had SO much to talk about we ended up filming a 2-part show. The first segment will air at 9:00 AM, PDT TODAY. The second segment will air next Wednesday, November 9th at 9:00 AM, PDT.

This was a very interesting conversation that you won't want to miss!!!

Be sure and subscribe to my Rumble channel and click on the notifications bell. Rumble is a platform that's still allowing free speech!!

Thanks for watching The Rachel Hamm Show!

With Grateful Heart,
Rachel

body:
#
Friends -
I’ve served Wisconsin in the State Assembly, as Lieutenant Governor, and now I'm running for U.S. Senate.
No matter what level of office I've served in, I’ve always looked to the facts to make tough decisions.
Right now, the facts are telling me that we are in serious trouble.
Ron Johnson is attacking abortion rights, denying the devastating reality of the climate crisis, threatening the future of our democracy, and spreading misinformation about everything from January 6th to the COVID pandemic. **But I refuse to let him win.**
I didn't spend many months traveling the state of Wisconsin hearing directly from folks about the need to rebuild the middle class, codify Roe, and address the climate crisis just for far-right extremists like Ron Johnson to halt our progress.
I believe we need more leaders who will look to the facts, trust the science, and act boldly to address the many crises we face – [**can you make a $3 contribution to show that you agree?**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mandela-em-nov22.Jaf-Cy&refcode=em221102-1-gm-p11&t=1&akid=3937%2E196590%2Exyug_1)
My grandfather didn't serve in the Navy more than 70 years ago to defend our democracy only to have Ron Johnson try to overturn the election results in 2020.
I believe we need leaders who will have faith in the promise of our democratic processes rather than defend violent insurrectionists and conspiracy theories – [**can you make a $3 contribution to show that you agree?**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mandela-em-nov22.Jaf-Cy&refcode=em221102-1-gm-p11&t=2&akid=3937%2E196590%2Exyug_1)
Ron Johnson would rather lie to Wisconsinites and the American people than accept the facts. And we only have 6 days left to defeat him, which is why I need to ask you again:
[**Can you please chip in $3 to my campaign today? I need your help to flip Wisconsin's Senate seat, and time is running out.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mandela-em-nov22.Jaf-Cy&refcode=em221102-1-gm-p11&t=3&akid=3937%2E196590%2Exyug_1)

Mandela

clean_body: Friends - I’ve served Wisconsin in the State Assembly, as Lieutenant Governor, and now I'm running for U.S. Senate. No matter what level of office I've served in, I’ve always looked to the facts to make tough decisions. Right now, the facts are telling me that we are in serious trouble. Ron Johnson is attacking abortion rights, denying the devastating reality of the climate crisis, threatening the future of our democracy, and spreading misinformation about everything from January 6th to the COVID pandemic. But I refuse to let him win. I didn't spend many months traveling the state of Wisconsin hearing directly from folks about the need to rebuild the middle class, codify Roe, and address the climate crisis just for far-right extremists like Ron Johnson to halt our progress. I believe we need more leaders who will look to the facts, trust the science, and act boldly to address the many crises we face – My grandfather didn't serve in the Navy more than 70 years ago to defend our democracy only to have Ron Johnson try to overturn the election results in 2020. I believe we need leaders who will have faith in the promise of our democratic processes rather than defend violent insurrectionists and conspiracy theories – Ron Johnson would rather lie to Wisconsinites and the American people than accept the facts. And we only have 6 days left to defeat him, which is why I need to ask you again: Thank you for being a part of this campaign. This is going to be an incredibly close race and every donation makes a big difference. Mandela

Wow, friend, after last night’s grassroots rally with President Barack Obama, I am more fired up and inspired to fight than I've ever been. **[Please, will you split a donation of $5 between my campaign and the DSCC to protect Nevada's Senate seat and our Democratic majority?](https://go.dscc.org/go/3085?amount=5&t=5&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C50&code=DPE-FM-20221102-CatherineCortezMasto-CCMTandem-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FM-20221102-CatherineCortezMasto-CCMTandem-Pros-sl1&akid=8408%2E9716520%2E1XTQQf)**

Together, President Obama and I spoke to Nevada voters about everything that's on the line in this race – reproductive rights, our Democratic Senate majority, the future of free and fair elections and our very democracy. **Truly, all of it comes down to whether I hold this seat – because if we lose, Democrats cannot hold the Senate.**

**So there is grave cause for concern:** as we were on stage, and as I write to you now, Mitch McConnell is bombarding Nevada's airwaves with ads viciously attacking me – **just as new polling shows me statistically tied with my Trump-backed opponent.**

I left the stage feeling so hopeful, but that hope is now mixed with unease about McConnell’s newest barrage of attack ads. I’m worried that if we’re outspent and drowned out on the airwaves in these final days, with minimal resources to fight back, we will lose.

**My team and I set a goal to raise $250,000 in the wake of the rally because it’s our ONLY chance of winning this race, but I just heard we’re falling short. We absolutely cannot fall short at moments like this:[Please, will you split $5 between my campaign and the DSCC to help keep Nevada and the Senate blue?](https://go.dscc.org/go/3085?amount=5&t=6&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C50&code=DPE-FM-20221102-CatherineCortezMasto-CCMTandem-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FM-20221102-CatherineCortezMasto-CCMTandem-Pros-sl1&akid=8408%2E9716520%2E1XTQQf)**

We have _6 days_ left to tip the scales in this deadlocked race, and I know we can do it if we all do our part. Thank you so much for being on my team.

_¡La lucha sigue!_ The fight continues!

Catherine Cortez Masto
U.S. Senator, Nevada

[](https://go.dscc.org/go/3085?amount=5&t=7&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C50&code=DPE-FM-20221102-CatherineCortezMasto-CCMTandem-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FM-20221102-CatherineCortezMasto-CCMTandem-Pros-sl1&akid=8408%2E9716520%2E1XTQQf)

It connects Veterans with Veterans in swing states and races across the country
#
Derek -
Yes, we are spending more money on ads than almost any other progressive organization ahead of this election.
But we are also running one of the largest organizing efforts in the country as well.
We call it “Operation Voter Storm,” and it connects Veterans with Veterans in swing states and races across the country, focuses on in-depth conversations that can swing votes, and then we turn them out.
So far, we have contacted over half a million veterans and military families in key states like Arizona, Georgia, and Wisconsin.
Think about all the close races out there. Races that will determine control of Congress.
Now recognize that every vote we flip is worth two! One away from the Republicans and one for the Democrats.
These conversations are personal. They cut through the clutter. They deliver. But we need your help to continue funding the program.

body:

| | | | | Peter, we need to protect every Senate seat on Election Day, seven short days from now. It’s just a little over two months away, and Republicans are still hoping voters won’t punish them for the Dobbs decision that ended Roe v. Wade. Take Blake Masters, Republican Senate candidate for Arizona, challenging Democratic Sen. Mark Kelly: **Blake Masters thinks his anti-immigrant rhetoric and some quick website scrubbing can make his history of anti-abortion extremism just disappear.** The puppet of right wing, ultra-weird West Coast billionaire Peter Thiel, who in the past has fondly quoted Hermann Goring, Masters decided his talk about a "Personhood Amendment" that would declare life from the moment of conception, and arresting women and doctors in the dystopian police state of his dreams needed to disappear, as it was hurting him in the polls. **_So, Masters took it down off of his website, and claims Mark Kelly and the rest of us are lying when we quote what he had on his site this summer, and which you can still find on video._** [**Can you please join us in stopping Masters by supporting Mark Kelly with a donation of $2, $5, $10. or whatever you can afford? Kelly doesn't have a billionaire pulling his strings and writing him checks for tens of millions of dollars.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T87d841c8-36aa-4056-959a-6838c10e0e64/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) That is the kind of thoroughly dishonest stooge we're dealing with in Masters. It's probably why he was endorsed by loud and proud Neo-Nazi Andrew Anglin on the vicious neo-Nazi news site,_The Daily Stormer, _and wouldn't even reject the endorsement at first. **_But we won't let Masters get away with this. There is only one conscientiously pro-woman, pro-choice candidate in this race, and it is Mark Kelly. The astronaut, combat pilot and gun safety activist who fought for better laws after his wife, former Rep. Gabby Giffords, was shot through the head and grieviously injured._**

The Left wants the next generation of Black Americans to self-destruct.
[](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c8cbc0b858ec42c8912184da8904ed50&_e=VsKYxyta9-F5JImAKKrslneo0juKkEMbk6gK7V0VvbdSfezlLjdIfQt4iPGGChwmxSwngmmOPTjOS7T64980r6tuMWvovBQY4DeqehKwDJwVZQYJAJ6R_CmhC0IiPxJ2o0sXw_torK-cdvKyWs4Vgh-BKla6qhPpgj4Pqh3Pf6AnyicO_Xz3_OQOYNTMjVyVyOkbiIFhA7xnb4jDNr0WhHMWCm5lr35Hsuk2-szEthclprq7pgar2QCg5Yvg9M50IxqcDDn9trVflW0Q_FXlONYJGJ5fOVcvEIGolFrq_VY%3D)

Hello Friend,

The Left wants the next generation of Black Americans to self-destruct. They have set out to destroy our families, defund the police, and leave our communities vulnerable.

And if the Left succeeds, the next generation will have no family to support them and become victims of crime in their own neighborhoods.

I saw a video of a group of Black teens DESTROYING a local store in their own community. This was where their parents and grandparents shopped, and these children destroyed it for no reason -- _**just because they were bored.**_

My name is Brandom Tatum, an ex-police officer and co-founder of the BLEXIT Foundation.

**BLEXIT is extending an opportunity for you to get involved and empower Black communities by opening pro-police dialogues.**

Friend, I've set a goal to raise $24,000 in the next 48 hours to support our work to build strong communities and stop the over-incarceration of minorities among the next generation.

[_**Can you join us in our mission by sending a gift of $10, $25, $50, or any amount? Click here to send your gift >>>**_](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c8cbc0b858ec42c8912184da8904ed50&_e=VsKYxyta9-F5JImAKKrslneo0juKkEMbk6gK7V0VvbdSfezlLjdIfQt4iPGGChwmxSwngmmOPTjOS7T64980r6tuMWvovBQY4DeqehKwDJwVZQYJAJ6R_CmhC0IiPxJ2o0sXw_torK-cdvKyWs4VguWy6VEisvQVhkE-1z9o8EThJrrMIHGtexM4e-vXwVvEVeIp6tduH6YGFJtchA7oegTe5l0BHc2rtRuQthdb9DWK_93tH7tUvrISpNTOx1rlRSLXGMoK5p1cDPxquCxyFW21LV68VLVxKiIk7brYWrI%3D)

The only limits we face come from the person in the mirror.
* Not from our skin color.
* Not from where we grow up.
* Not from a broken family.

This is a deeply personal topic to me. I served in the Tucson Police Department as a SWAT operator, field training officer, general instructor, and Public Information Officer.

**I know how important it is to create relationships between police officers and these communities.**

Black communities must end the victimhood mentality that the media and other organizations force on us. It's why BLEXIT stresses the importance of education, family, the presence of a father in the home, and the support of a strong community to _**avoid**_ incarceration.

[_**Support BLEXIT 's mission to reach urban communities >>>**_](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c8cbc0b858ec42c8912184da8904ed50&_e=VsKYxyta9-F5JImAKKrslneo0juKkEMbk6gK7V0VvbdSfezlLjdIfQt4iPGGChwmxSwngmmOPTjOS7T64980r6tuMWvovBQY4DeqehKwDJwVZQYJAJ6R_CmhC0IiPxJ2o0sXw_torK-cdvKyWs4VguokU2JcBP853XOlA8oKz7Na-JNTXAvJO4fv-4_BY5nBHYgpU9pjOnOjGyanyX4sn1xT4xUDVZ4_mpgzz9zNJKBmPKwqPRplARfV_NL8I7lXWqmtqEfKNYKxxZykBMsob2P1jwgdOHidb55JxwC-Psk%3D)

When I co-founded BLEXIT, I promised myself that we would not be just a "think tank" but a thoughtful and quick-acting "DO-tank."

We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing and going places that are often ignored, like Detroit and Baltimore.

We believe there are five primary program areas in which BLEXIT Foundation must engage to change the narrative surrounding America's minority communities.
* Advocating for School Choice.
* Promoting a pro-police criminal justice reform.
* Championing entrepreneurship and free enterprise.
* Developing history programs that will inspire minority children.
* Presenting the message of BLEXIT through art and live experiences.

All while championing our values of faith, family, and freedom to empower Black and minority communities.

Friend --

The 2022 midterms are about monumental choices, including choices about democracy itself.

The work you have helped All On The Line accomplish has gone a long way toward strengthening our democracy. A recent _New York Times_ analysis found that the maps for the House of Representatives are the fairest in 40 years – and that’s because folks like you got involved and made your voices heard. But that doesn’t mean the work stops there. We need to not only protect the progress we have made, but also build on it.

This year, we have an opportunity to vote on terms that are, if not perfect, then closer to the ideals we have always told ourselves this nation stands for.

Like our imperfect union, the maps still need work -- and we’re counting on your support to continue that work. But in the short term, we need to focus on getting out to vote, and encouraging our friends and loved ones to do the same.

**Your vote -- and your right to vote -- directly affects other rights, too.** Whether it’s the right to choose, the right to love who you love, or the state-by-state rights about your ability to go to the polls on Election Day, everything is on the ballot this November. | | | **Facebook won’t let us run these ads, folks:**
---
[](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tfb24ce40-b49c-4026-99c5-398198414ee0/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
| | | Researchers recently found that Facebook is approving a significant number of advertisements with “blatant” misinformation about the 2022 midterms and the integrity of the voting process. But somehow, our completely factual ads about MAGA Republicans and their plans to contest the 2024 election failed to pass Facebook’s review process. _So what’s up with that?!_ We wish we knew. But what we do know is that the future of our democracy hangs in the balance — largely because of misinformation — and Facebook still won’t do what’s necessary to help. The best way to stand up to Mark Zuckerberg is to join the work to fight back against the disinformation that Zuckerberg won't do anything about, and we've got a plan for that. [**That’s why we’re reaching out, friend. Add your name if you’re with us to fight the right-wing disinformation that Zuckerberg won’t. We’ll give you easy, concrete ways to take action. **](https://default.salsalabs.org/T6bb34332-32cd-4927-a836-94342f49648b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | Facebook has been under scrutiny for years for its role in the election process, and many of those same problems have persisted — and in some cases worsened. For some reason, Zuckerberg and his company fail to understand the urgency of this moment. Platforms like Facebook continue to have an outsized impact on our democracy, and it’s time to fight back since they won’t. # Who is the real extremist in CD7?
---
|
---
|
---
| | |
---|---
|
Who is the real extremist in the seventh district congressional race?
Brittany Pettersen portrays herself as a moderate while allowing her high-dollar media team to levy baseless accusations against me. But despite these efforts, her voting record and policy positions reveal her unsettling and destructive radicalism.
In contrast, I stand for balanced and responsible governance that puts party aside to get things done for Colorado and America.
| | |
---|---
|
Brittany Pettersen voted to lower penalties for possessing lethal amounts of fentanyl. What has followed is an unprecedented number of deaths (approaching 1500 in Colorado alone), mostly young people, from the drug. Many users do not realize that they are taking fentanyl. Chinese agencies manufacture this dangerous drug and provide it to cartels who transport it across the southern border to flood the American streets. It is a carefully designed, heinous attack on our country.
We must not tolerate this lawlessness. As a Congressman, I will strive to ensure our laws are enforced and drug dealers are held accountable for their crimes. Whereas Joe Biden and Nancy Pelosi have left the southern border open (and Brittany Pettersen agrees with that) a secure southern border is key to restoring public safety and national security.
| | |
---|---
|
Brittany Pettersen has no answers for meeting our future energy needs. She has only the ideologically driven, naive intent to abruptly move away from oil and natural gas and switch to intermittent solar and wind power prematurely. This extreme and dangerous path would be disastrous to our economy and undermine our national security.
Any energy expert will acknowledge the continuing need for oil and natural gas in the short to medium term, and that increased natural gas utilization has had the greatest impact on reducing harmful emissions. The Biden administration's destruction of domestic oil and natural gas production has made us reliant on hostile foreign sources, jeopardized our national security, and contributed to nearly doubling the cost of fuel products over two years.
| |
---|---
|
There is a better way. Having spent a decade working all over the world in the energy sector, I understand how to establish sustainable energy independence for our nation. We must protect our environment while restoring sound energy policy. If we steward our natural resources responsibly, we can seek sustainability without diminishing national security, the economy, living standards, or global power and competitive advantage. Wise use of existing sources of energy, coupled with well-researched, market-proven emerging technologies, will enhance lifestyles for everyone while preserving our planet for future generations.
| | |
---|---
|
Brittany Pettersen sees increasing taxes on fuel as being a beneficial use of government power, even though this added cost during an economic downturn hurts every citizen in the state. In addition, she has no response to the malaise besetting our economy except to increase government spending, in spite of the fact that excessive spending is exactly what has caused today's inflation crisis. She clearly supports increasing this insidious hidden tax on the American people.
I will seek to end wasteful federal spending from day one in office. I believe Congress must carefully manage government spending with a consistent view towards reducing costs and waste.

Furthermore, I will lead in returning government to its proper role as designed by the Constitution. It is not the role of government to live our lives and make our decisions for us. The enormous success of our nation comes from opportunity and freedom to pursue one's dreams.
| | |
---|---
|
Brittany Pettersen is too extreme for Colorado and for the country. Despite her hollow claims of being a "fighter" for citizens, she will only fall in line with her Washington bosses. We do not need another rubber stamp for the destruction of opportunity and the erosion of the rule of law.
If you want to restore balance and responsibility to our government, I would be honored to have your vote. I am a proven leader in combat and business. I bring experience that a career politician like Brittany Pettersen simply does not possess. In all of our policy challenges, I am well prepared to seek that precious middle point between right and left to find the answer that best serves each individual, promotes harmony and respect between us, and preserves our beloved liberty.
|
---

Brittany Pettersen portrays herself as a moderate while allowing her high-dollar media team to levy baseless accusations against me. But despite these efforts, her voting record and policy positions reveal her unsettling and destructive radicalism. In contrast, I stand for balanced and responsible governance that puts party aside to get things done for Colorado and America. | | | ---|--- | Brittany Pettersen voted to lower penalties for possessing lethal amounts of fentanyl. What has followed is an unprecedented number of deaths (approaching 1500 in Colorado alone), mostly young people, from the drug. Many users do not realize that they are taking fentanyl. Chinese agencies manufacture this dangerous drug and provide it to cartels who transport it across the southern border to flood the American streets. It is a carefully designed, heinous attack on our country. We must not tolerate this lawlessness. As a Congressman, I will strive to ensure our laws are enforced and drug dealers are held accountable for their crimes. This extreme and dangerous path would be disastrous to our economy and undermine our national security. Any energy expert will acknowledge the continuing need for oil and natural gas in the short to medium term, and that increased natural gas utilization has had the greatest impact on reducing harmful emissions. The Biden administration's destruction of domestic oil and natural gas production has made us reliant on hostile foreign sources, jeopardized our national security, and contributed to nearly doubling the cost of fuel products over two years. | | ---|--- | There is a better way. body:
Message from Catherine Engelbrecht | | |
---
|
---
|
---
| | Dear Friend,

If we were living in normal times, Catherine would be updating you on the work of True the Vote. However, as you may have heard, she and Gregg Phillips were arrested Monday morning, October 31, 2022, for refusing to divulge the name of an FBI confidential informant. My name is Karen, and I am a True the Vote team member. Catherine has asked me, from her jail cell, to fill you all in on recent troubling developments.

Since it has been a while since our last newsletter, let’s review the investigations by True the Vote that have become public in the last few months and have led to the standoff in federal court in Texas this week.

**Since January 2021** , True the Vote has worked to uncover the role Konnech, a Michigan-based election management software company with what appears to be deep ties to the Chinese Communist Party, and has potentially played in the subversion of America's elections.

The True the Vote team was made aware that the personal information of nearly two million American election workers was stored on a server in China, in violation of US law, as well as Konnech’s contracts between many states and counties. This information included poll worker names, addresses, phone numbers, social security numbers and bank account numbers. Realizing the severe national security implications of the data breach, Gregg Phillips and True the Vote immediately turned over the findings to the FBI.

For 15 months Catherine and Gregg worked with FBI field agents in Texas on a counter-intelligence operation to end Konnech’s involvement in America’s elections. The FBI already had Konnech “on the radar” due to questionable activities that extended far beyond US elections.
---
|
---
| [SUPPORT TRUE THE VOTE](https://truethevote.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d9ab56570d4ecf7b7df9d4c25&id=c9c12c3c35&e=ad8cba7e98 "SUPPORT TRUE THE VOTE")
---
| **In April 2022, everything changed.**
Catherine received a call from one of the Texas-based FBI agents, who informed her that the FBI’s Washington D.C. office was now involved in the investigation. The Texas agent informed them that it was possible that they were going to be the targets of the FBI. He suggested that their best option was to go public with what they had learned.

**In August 2022** , Catherine and Gregg convened a meeting called “The Pit.” At the event they told their story for the first time in public to an audience that included citizen researchers, journalists, and law enforcement personnel.

**In September 2022** , Konnech sued True the Vote for defamation, racism, and xenophobia for revealing their findings publicly. The court issued a temporary restraining order (TRO) to Catherine and Gregg that required them, among other things, to provide to Konnech the names of all the individuals who were involved in the discovery of the poll worker data in China.

To put this in context, here is a quote from this recent article in AND Magazine by former CIA operations officer, Sam Faddis:

* * *

_“Let’s imagine that a drug dealer facing criminal charges filed a lawsuit in civil court to make the cops provide the name of a source inside his organization. Would anyone think for a moment that would be a reasonable request? Would anyone have any doubt as to the fate of the informant if he was identified?_

_That’s how ludicrous this is and how obscene.”_

* * *

**On October 4, 2022** , the company’s CEO, Eugene Yu, was indicted in California on charges including fraud, embezzlement, and data breach resulting in the theft of the personal information of election workers in LA County. The arrest was announced by LA District Attorney, George Gascon.

The arrest was the result of an indictment by a grand jury convened in Los Angeles, which is the nation’s largest voting bloc.

LA County is just the first of many counties that True the Vote is working to support. There are far more layers of subversion still to be exposed, with this company .... and potentially many others.

**October 7, 2022** , Catherine and Gregg’s attorneys made an initial appearance in federal court in Houston to answer the civil lawsuit filed by Konnech. It was at this hearing that the judge issued a highly unusual order...that Catherine and Gregg (through their attorneys) reveal the name of the individual who originally presented them with the poll worker data on the server in China. Their attorney reluctantly complied and revealed the name of this individual.

**October 27, 2022** , Catherine and Gregg appeared in federal court in Houston prepared to demonstrate that there was a criminal matter in LA County regarding Eugene Yu and Konnech. The judge refused to consider this evidence and directed Catherine and Gregg to reveal publicly the name of the other individual in the hotel room where Gregg viewed the poll worker data in January 2021. Catherine and Gregg offered to cooperate with the court and Konnech’s lawyers by providing the name of this individual under seal. The judge refused this offer. At the end of a long day of testimony by Catherine and Gregg, the judge found them in contempt of court. They were provided an opportunity to “cure” the contempt on Monday, October 31 at 9:00 AM by revealing the name of the second individual in the hotel room. If they did not “cure” it, they would be immediately remanded into custody by the US Marshals.

body:
Here's the bottom line: The sky won't fall if you don't chip in, but your support DOES matter.
Peter,

We are in the final push to Election Day, and my team and I have been working non-stop to get out the vote. Monday was our FINAL end-of-month deadline before Election Day, and we've got more to do!

Look, we have a lot of work ahead of us in the next SIX days. And with so much on the line, from reproductive freedom to Social Security, we can't afford to slow down.

Reaching voters on TV and online, sending out mailers, and fueling our volunteer efforts take serious resources. That's why I'm counting on your help to ensure we have the resources to fuel our Get-Out-The-Vote push to Election Day.

name: Kyrsten Sinema
subject: Dreamers in our communities have earned the same access to higher education as all other Arizonans
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sinema for Arizona
body:
|
#
---
One of the most valuable lessons I learned as a kid was the importance of studying hard. My family faced hard times and struggled, and I knew that hard work and a good, affordable education were my tickets to a better life. In Arizona, we all want the same things: to work hard, follow the rules, earn an education, get a good job, and provide for our families. That includes Dreamers, young adults who were brought to the U.S. as young children and for years have called Arizona home. Right now, Arizona Dreamers hoping to attend public colleges in Arizona are forced to pay out-of-state tuition. That goes against our Arizona values. All Arizona students who graduate from Arizona high schools have earned the opportunity to attend college at the in-state tuition rate. **That’s why I voted Yes on Proposition 308, so that Dreamers in our communities have the same access to higher education as all other Arizonans.** [**I encourage you to join me in voting Yes on Prop. 308. Together, we can ensure all Arizona Dreamers are eligible for in-state tuition so they can work hard and build better lives for themselves and their families. Friend, have you or do you plan to vote Yes on Prop. 308? If so, sign our petition below.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53902864/376849157/-1616703064?refcode=AU_KLS_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20221102_PM1_V1_S3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84OTMxNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1YzVhYmYxZC1mNjVhLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lC_wQDonDKEK_ZW73p2hVLuezF78f22QhA7GpziEbBU=&emci=4d5abf1d-f65a-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=5c5abf1d-f65a-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=2415496) | [YES on Prop. 308](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53902865/376849158/-1616703064?refcode=AU_KLS_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20221102_PM1_V1_S3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84OTMxNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1YzVhYmYxZC1mNjVhLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lC_wQDonDKEK_ZW73p2hVLuezF78f22QhA7GpziEbBU=&emci=4d5abf1d-f65a-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=5c5abf1d-f65a-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=2415496)

body:
If we want to transform what is possible in Washington, we must not allow super PACs who want to uphold a corrupt and broken status quo to buy this Senate seat.

[](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-nov22.g3HOlK&refcode=em221102-1-MA&t=1&akid=2203%2E357359%2E2fozcl)
I had a rare moment of free time between campaign stops, and I wanted to use it to reach out to you. I’ve been reflecting a lot lately on our journey since we launched this campaign over 18 months ago. I get asked why I decided to run for Senate a lot on the campaign trail, so I wanted to share a little bit about my decision today.
As a judge and Chief Justice of the North Carolina Supreme Court, I saw up close how justice was too often out of reach for people. I saw the ways laws handed down by Washington leave our families behind — all while corporate interests rake in record profits. Politicians in Washington have allowed the wealthy and well-connected to get ahead for far too long.
DC insiders like my opponent have forgotten who they were elected to serve, and I knew this race was a real opportunity for North Carolinians to have a change. We need a leader in the Senate who will be a voice for all of us and break through the division and gridlock to deliver real change for our families.
But this race is the toughest campaign I’ve ever run. I’ve never faced more lies and vicious attacks, and my opponent is being propped up by over $63 million in outside spending. I cannot take on and defeat this amount of dark money alone. It takes a dedicated grassroots effort — folks like you and me rolling up our sleeves to move mountains together.

# **CA GOP Chair Jessica Patterson in Stockton for Final Weekend of Campaign**
---
|
---
| STOCKTON, CA - The Chairwoman of the California Republican Party will be in Stockton on Saturday, November 5th, ahead of Tuesday’s election as more pollsters predict not just a “red wave” but a “red tsunami.” She will be here for a “Rally in the Valley” at the County GOP campaign headquarters in Stockton.

Joining her is San Joaquin County Supervisor Tom Patti who is poised to flip a Democrat congressional seat in CA-9, and Lanhee Chen, the Republican Nominee for State Controller, who is poised to become the first California Republican Controller in almost 50 years.

Patterson, Patti, and Chen will be speaking at 9 AM followed by door knocking in the local community. All press is invited to attend the rally and walk. Click the button below to RSVP for location and to confirm attendance.
---
| [RSVP to GOTV Rally with Tom Patti, Jessica Patterson, and Lanhee Chen](https://tompattiforcongress.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=35b3ff69952b238846e5a10cc&id=553a85868f&e=5d7a2268d7 "RSVP to GOTV Rally with Tom Patti, Jessica Patterson, and Lanhee Chen")
---
|
---
| **About Supervisor Tom Patti:** Tom was raised in San Joaquin County and has run a successful local business for decades. He was elected to the San Joaquin County Board of Supervisors in 2016 by an overwhelming margin.

As a County Supervisor, community volunteer, and parent, Tom has worked and dedicated his efforts to safer neighborhoods, demanded real action to reduce homelessness, and advocated for improving the quality, accessibility, and availability of local healthcare.

Tom Patti has worked hard to support veterans, improve and fund our community colleges, support our farmers, advanced workforce equity and created many new job opportunities.

Learn more by visiting [www.TomPattiForCongress.com](https://tompattiforcongress.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=35b3ff69952b238846e5a10cc&id=0282adab45&e=5d7a2268d7)

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: The importance of exercising your right to vote
body:
For decades, faith-based votership has been in steep decline. |
---
| | Hi Friend,

I hope you’re doing well. This is Dr. Ben Carson, and I’m writing to you today because recently I’ve noticed a troubling trend.

For decades, faith-based votership has been in steep decline. This sure concerns me, and since I’m sure it troubles you too, I’m hoping we can work to reverse this trend together.

_**Our nation is at a crossroads.**_ And today it’s critical for the faith-based community to [turn out in force to vote during next week’s midterm elections.](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=ef2907cdd3a54c9682dd15c723760330&_e=kiMzLxEdkYF2Diz39l2vZaDTGvL2CtwClnZJGH73sVFySih-YkvF1tng9ImjtsjQlBacaDL_mTAtHd_JjWSsTbYWLyNp4GtDygtFkCOjqLxmfl_7miKcXYfG5gEgyu1Jjj1dB68p27xh_R6lvijt3i1PRhaMUXzC4y6ztTDN-WD6YirumldqgaWYPPO6HdZ7RPxUrPi9pQWrJ3dMuW0B13H7Yd3AA9iHRe8ijN7Vu4kMeOlKncBJ92HYvl-OIYYDwPHuLDDF-O1pVHq-CNIRFvE2IPF5kTnzcIK3NR-h5VFDOBK8MqARc1U4CO7zOQJ5acHPuN8dwwXa0N9SCApqfRjp4vZRjud1cjfWHeYgd1HM-CfSmTNQwQ4aqy77HSic)

As voters of faith, you and I are called to consider carefully who will serve as our representatives in the halls of Congress and in state legislatures. And depending upon where you live, you’ll also be voting on state ballot initiatives and other local races that will directly impact you and your family.

We must speak out on the ongoing battle for hearts and minds across America—we must cast our vote in defense of the issues that matter most.

**This is why right now ACI is leading an initiative to educate citizens of faith about the importance of exercising your right to vote. **

And I’m hoping that as a leader of faith I can count on you to light the way forward by serving as an example and pledging to vote in next week’s pivotal midterm elections.

**If you are willing to step up and inspire others to join in on this critical initiative, please take a moment to sign our pledge by clicking the link below:**

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/pledge-to-vote/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=ef2907cdd3a54c9682dd15c723760330&_e=kiMzLxEdkYF2Diz39l2vZaDTGvL2CtwClnZJGH73sVFySih-YkvF1tng9ImjtsjQlBacaDL_mTAtHd_JjWSsTbYWLyNp4GtDygtFkCOjqLxmfl_7miKcXYfG5gEgyu1Jjj1dB68p27xh_R6lvijt3i1PRhaMUXzC4y6ztTDN-WD6YirumldqgaWYPPO6HdZ7RPxUrPi9pQWrJ3dMuW0B1-wND4grnpp7nopLssKNsGx8paIi7GEJy7_HNfyTYsPUK7VEukyRd1RXMm-9icv85MqYxNmaS523aI8CWB7xPRjDIXH3oVf4gKvHJqj9pXiaUZygZItmorNshaUha4tfaag7Je9QymmyqBYP1PCaI5I3qizIQlHvONknXgumCajb)**

When you do, you’ll be signaling to other voters of faith that we have to unite and take action by casting our vote next week.

Thank you for helping with this critical initiative,

Dr. Ben Carson

Hey there,

I don't want to scare you, but Election Day is just days away. The Pennsylvania Senate Race is TIED, and we need to pull ahead.

John Fetterman has Chuck Schumer dumping almost $5 Million into this race, AND with Joe Biden and Far Left Liberals on his side -- he can do just about anything.

[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Hi Derek,

A few days ago, President Obama joined Stacey and our entire statewide
ticket in Atlanta.

With less than a week left until Election Day and our democracy on the
line, President Obama made it clear: we can’t get complacent now. We need
every supporter to fight alongside Stacey in these final days.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/6203?refcode=sa_em_221102_B3_ObamaMessage_S1_T1_TA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=16648%2E1862389%2EjKBb1e ]And we need the resources in the last 6 days of this race to reach
every voter possible before the polls close. With record turnout at over
1.9 million votes already cast in this election, this is hardly the time
to slow down. If you chip in $5, we can keep shattering
turnout records and win this election. Will you join President Obama in
the fight to get Stacey over the finish line with your
first donation now?

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/6203?refcode=sa_em_221102_B3_ObamaMessage_S1_T1_TA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=16648%2E1862389%2EjKBb1e ]DONATE

Derek,
President Obama knows why it’s absolutely
critical that we elect Stacey Abrams as the next Governor of Georgia.

He knows the women of Georgia deserve the right to choose what happens to
their bodies. He knows that we can protect the Second Amendment and second
graders at the same time. He knows our democracy is on the line. And most
of all, he knows that Brian Kemp is one of the most dangerous governors of
our time.

With Stacey’s vision on the ballot this election, we have a chance to
elect a leader who’s done the work for Georgia and envisions a future
where we don’t just survive — but thrive.

And President Obama and Stacey Abrams had one unified message: voting will
not be a miracle cure-all in this election, but it will set us on the path
to address illnesses that we’ve long suffered.

So, if we’re going to get to work, like President Obama said, we need you
right there with us in this final week. Can you donate $5

You can now own one of Hillsdale College’s most popular online courses, “Winston Churchill and Statesmanship,” on DVD. This sponsored message from Full Mag News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=2c6fddc7641e4f388d081d3f0f261d73&_e=eGp6mOndtl_6gUK8ysNFJuVDjj4r6qOOQyx_lVLvruzI6ReXF6BmFQR-ZpTf5sKD9jF6CqZfKdxi4veJRnWCQb7YltdYA3FrD2wjLz4MQSXkJFM0nh28GP7pW-BNmWuLV7h3Gf6r8fbDKGFl08mLeGNMGCMrJGchrzbbU3AIkhxIb9owFMaOWflFLPaSWLlyB4L-fvYpTCKP-5WVj25wbfBUcf8SC3JZQzODbutym-dMHSfTBmRFcqNe0RZn9Jorsyb0EorS9KwYrnC-dnSA3solwpTEzixI5QKF-2Nux1Te2khQEOYD5qAL2QEfNF7nuHIH1lu9tfK-MnqCgLLOoTQHZiuQEmf1Rmwffv-vm1jZ4FWorHkWHcUsD7Gt1ec-FtOrH0R2v_JqcZamqRl0xw%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, You can now own one of Hillsdale College's most popular online courses, **" Winston Churchill and Statesmanship,"** on DVD. Thousands of people have enjoyed this in-depth course online since its release, _**and now you can add it to your personal library or give it as a gift.**_ In recent years Winston Churchill, who is best known for his leadership during World War II, has been portrayed in numerous films and television shows, proving without a doubt that Americans find the "British Bulldog" captivating. I’m going to be out there working hard for the next 6 days — not just for my dad, but for every Pennsylvanian’s rights.

Hey, it’s Sophia Shapiro (Josh’s daughter)! Unlike most people, I get to see the two different sides of my dad: the public and the private side. In public, I see him on the campaign trail, on prime-time TV interviews, and working long hours as the People’s Attorney General. At home, I get to see my dad, joking with my brothers and me and supporting us in everything we do. From day one, my mom and dad have been my rock and have been on a mission to make a world for my siblings and me that is better than the one they grew up in. But my dad doesn’t stop caring when he leaves the house. He goes to work every day to make sure every family in Pennsylvania lives on safe streets and sends their kids to top-notch schools. Why? Because that’s just who my dad has always been. My dad may be the one running for Governor and it may be his name on the ballot – but this election is about every last Pennsylvanian. Derek, there remains an enormous amount of work to be done in Washington to address the climate crisis. Cheri Beasley understands that, and she believes that tackling the climate crisis is imperative to our health, economy, and security. That’s why we need candidates like her in the Senate to make more progress possible. North Carolina is considered the birthplace of the environmental justice movement, and it has one of the closest Senate races in the country this November. I didn’t spend more than 54 days in space observing the damage climate change is wreaking on our planet just for far-right extremists to deny the truth and refuse to take action. Mark

name: Adam Schiff
subject: A closing pitch on why Val Demings deserves your support
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR CONGRESS
body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=1250%2E5257348%2EjcnS-o ]Adam Schiff for Congress

Derek,

When Speaker Pelosi was putting together our team to prosecute Donald J.
Trump’s first impeachment in his Senate trial, Val Demings was an obvious
choice.

Before her election to Congress, Val served for 27 years in the Orlando
Police Department and rose to become the first Black woman to lead the
department as Chief of Police. Chief Demings... has a nice ring to it.

Val has had the experience, the grit, and the sense of duty and fidelity
to our Constitution to serve her community for all those years, and that’s
exactly why she belongs in the United States Senate.

That’s also why Val is the absolute last person Donald Trump wants to see
in the Senate — and the Sunday before Election Day, Trump is holding a
massive Get-Out-The-Vote MAGA rally with Republican Sen. Marco Rubio to

We only have 6 days before this election is OVER! Join us this Saturday at a location near you to turn out the Republican vote!

http://wsrp.org

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WeGlgXqOx-Y

With ballots out, now is the perfect time to get out there and volunteer on a conservative campaign. Every door you knock on in these local races matter a lot and the results of this election year will be used as a bellwether for the 2022 midterms.

We are also hosting another WSRP Statewide Day Of Action on Saturday, October 30th! Bring a friend or neighbor to volunteer for a few hours to help local conservatives win in November! Sign up here to join our Statewide Day Of Action! (https://form.jotform.com/212737084845058)
State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .
