disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY GEORGE LOGAN
body:
This is a photo of my mom and dad. They instilled the very values I live by today. | [](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=795a250560ef4ceb9331e8bbac203bb7&_e=g5K0FR3rMPrVbptICW3dtaOpt9wsuI8ciqTnaZkhb3whVKVvUF-oOG9onCVOcTxvxpv0VvUSuiFQiD36EjjILOzbmZiMxSdnqBTmvaLazIQJGT-B554HOHpJpM_rbZYNadj4ItdokvAi04cYS3vVB9oPwHO-0_S_vfhSiW35aOPFXz84bDzhDCLepuokZd_b4nWfGmLyN1yuLygUCllWdjssVxQSOcRRzqxS5iWWEP_pfSOn-c_zEHMN2BG-KPhk6KIMNIsHzkeKUQ-p5nihrPYOFVmaC3gEiQTQ43V-8cdmg3zuiUdesLJV6SCef0-FJBTHAYPBGYlmiDsPZPhNgs3S-5ZzMsmwk-fYNu9zAkUvDgyNQXxZsXAHq2Fa-JgcITX2G09_HXQzY_YiFIHOL-kZStoJK0RhW1MK5B_QP0n70FCOCDRhMVlSIwzDqQDJ)

---

Peter,

Thank you for opening this email. I wanted to take a few minutes to share a few moments in my life and my upbringing that have made me who I am today.

[](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=795a250560ef4ceb9331e8bbac203bb7&_e=g5K0FR3rMPrVbptICW3dtaOpt9wsuI8ciqTnaZkhb3whVKVvUF-oOG9onCVOcTxvxpv0VvUSuiFQiD36EjjILOzbmZiMxSdnqBTmvaLazIQJGT-B554HOHpJpM_rbZYNadj4ItdokvAi04cYS3vVB9oPwHO-0_S_vfhSiW35aOPFXz84bDzhDCLepuokZd_b4nWfGmLyN1yuLygUCllWdjssVxQSOcRRzqxS5iWWEP_pfSOn-c_zEHMN2BG-KPhk6KIMNIsHzkeKUQ-p5nihrPYOFVmaC3gEiQTQ43V-8celkrm1nr14hyeWPdZxXamqo9ernQJV3mm8-A-hHXLmVghxKxgDA-oklSkXuHKMY3HqLsitzwz86mnj8LR__v1bOSCH3IR0Dw9aSbQHBNfC-LSAtBUXbetiF69Q0MXmtq-5mgrCNHPFRxvahpZ0OTie)
This is a photo of my mom and dad. They instilled the very values I live by today, **which is to put your family first, to serve your community, to be as educated as possible, and to always work hard.**

My parents came to this great nation to live out their American dream. They worked day and night at factory jobs and office administrative work to ensure I was getting the education to land a better job so that I could pursue my American dream.

[](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=795a250560ef4ceb9331e8bbac203bb7&_e=g5K0FR3rMPrVbptICW3dtaOpt9wsuI8ciqTnaZkhb3whVKVvUF-oOG9onCVOcTxvxpv0VvUSuiFQiD36EjjILOzbmZiMxSdnqBTmvaLazIQJGT-B554HOHpJpM_rbZYNadj4ItdokvAi04cYS3vVB9oPwHO-0_S_vfhSiW35aOPFXz84bDzhDCLepuokZd_b4nWfGmLyN1yuLygUCllWdjssVxQSOcRRzqxS5iWWEP_pfSOn-c_zEHMN2BG-KPhk6KIMNIsHzkeKUQ-p5nihrPYOFVmaC3gEiQTQ43V-8ccrlI34NX65y8FXfgCTIdW2cGIEOdE2E96w-fqFlpV3KSZgig9sctfP3jkqBV__f6yQ4FmHRYPwaCXpV8SDo6MeUpMkJiNMxead0n4MJWsABoc_VHs_Np8q-xbzV5z1CPnOebXER5vC7YnJMaq-ovXa)
I am a first-generation college graduate, and I even earned my master’s degree. I had to take out a good amount of student loans, but as my parents taught me, my hard work would pay off.

I soon met my wife, Lisa, and we fell in love. She has always been my rock. She supported me by working as a nurse with the State Department of Mental Health and Addiction Services so **that I could open my own business and continue my American Dream.**

[](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=795a250560ef4ceb9331e8bbac203bb7&_e=g5K0FR3rMPrVbptICW3dtaOpt9wsuI8ciqTnaZkhb3whVKVvUF-oOG9onCVOcTxvxpv0VvUSuiFQiD36EjjILOzbmZiMxSdnqBTmvaLazIQJGT-B554HOHpJpM_rbZYNadj4ItdokvAi04cYS3vVB9oPwHO-0_S_vfhSiW35aOPFXz84bDzhDCLepuokZd_b4nWfGmLyN1yuLygUCllWdjssVxQSOcRRzqxS5iWWEP_pfSOn-c_zEHMN2BG-KPhk6KIMNIsHzkeKUQ-p5nihrPYOFVmaC3gEiQTQ43V-8cf66TykVW3b8IYeNOep8sefY1n9BHvqQDHTIqFlyyzVejvC9_DcbG9WqZWcdSmS4lla-V3aMT_-0o5fxrWag9yWDRpTr3PyAnT7sN4C1gLwMB6sQ08W9QFpgNn3xhyxdky8cLDKD85WoVhM77K_cWJ5)
Since then, we have had two amazing children - our oldest is a college graduate, and our youngest is enrolled. Lisa and I could not be prouder. But my goal is to continue making them proud of me; **my job as their role model is not done yet.**

I want them to see that no matter who you are and what your background is, you can achieve great things with hard work and dedication while still being able to serve the greater good and even future generations. **That is why I am running for Congress.**

[](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=795a250560ef4ceb9331e8bbac203bb7&_e=g5K0FR3rMPrVbptICW3dtaOpt9wsuI8ciqTnaZkhb3whVKVvUF-oOG9onCVOcTxvxpv0VvUSuiFQiD36EjjILOzbmZiMxSdnqBTmvaLazIQJGT-B554HOHpJpM_rbZYNadj4ItdokvAi04cYS3vVB9oPwHO-0_S_vfhSiW35aOPFXz84bDzhDCLepuokZd_b4nWfGmLyN1yuLygUCllWdjssVxQSOcRRzqxS5iWWEP_pfSOn-c_zEHMN2BG-KPhk6KIMNIsHzkeKUQ-p5nihrPYOFVmaC3gEiQTQ43V-8cdxUdF5c5WAD3iMlNCKoCV-zYp1ah285TEoKZu7zLM8JPhGvxEXz28Sm3IdcQUww_ymcJLpkjhHv3tb1poN7hbNPjoB9fWyjRyCVX0I8H2bv3Rs1fMSqr2q01QkNknjTgcxisWsVt4Bl1uQ2qORRzBP)
I have seen the mess that Nancy Pelosi and Joe Biden’s policies have brought upon our nation, and I have seen firsthand the struggles it has placed on my community. **I can’t stand the fact that this is the environment our children have to start their lives in.**

Our country has lost sight of our founding principles due to poor leadership and a lack of patriotism, and I’m ready to do something about it.

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. [1]Charles Booker

Peter, I’m asking you to help send me to Washington -- here’s
why:

There’s so much room to do so much great work because we’ve been
struggling for a long time. Kentucky is one of the poorest states in the
country, and we can do much better.

I want to go to Washington to cast a vote to codify your right to privacy
and make your own decisions.

I want to go to Washington to cast a vote to take care of our teachers and
make sure they get the benefits they deserve.

I want to go to Washington to vote to take care of our Veterans, so they
aren’t left out on the streets or forced to suffer from devastating
illnesses and injuries.

I want to go to Washington to vote for affordable and sustainable housing,
better infrastructure, more money coming to Kentucky, better wages, clean
air, and clean water.

I want to go to Washington to cast a vote to protect democracy.

---
| | Friend,**

**Our plan is clear: we must prioritize public safety. On the other hand, Laura Kelly has disrespected law enforcement and does not have any concrete plans to prioritize public safety. She just isn't a leader on this issue. We can’t let this go on for another four years - Kansans need a reliable plan and we need to respect and support our law enforcement. **Derek Schmidt is the public safety choice for governor and that’s why he’s received several key endorsements in this race:**
---
---
**Kansas Fraternal Order of Police -**_“Derek Schmidt is an incredible friend to law enforcement who has always had our backs as attorney general. We at the Fraternal Order of Police are thrilled he has made the choice to continue his public service and entered the race for governor.”_
---
---
**National Border Patrol Council -** _“We are proud to endorse Attorney General Derek Schmidt’s campaign for Kansas Governor...Derek has consistently advocated for the right policies when it comes to securing America’s southern border, and by extension keeping Kansas communities safe... Kansas deserves Attorney General Schmidt’s clear-eyed leadership as governor.”_
---
---
**National Latino Peace Officers Association -** _“The NLPOA-Advocacy supports Derek Schmidt because his vision is consistent with the type of Leader our country needs, especially with the current state of law enforcement profession. We invite our members and friends to support Derek Schmidt as he walks ‘side-by-side’ with Law Enforcement.”_
---

**David Groves, Cherokee County Sheriff -** _“Four years ago, I was optimistic the new governor would bring positive and meaningful changes to several areas impacting families and communities all across our state. But because of the lack of meaningful positive changes in many areas over the past four years, and Derek Schmidt’s long-time and consistent work towards keeping Kansas families safe, although I’m a registered Democrat, I’m proud to endorse Derek Schmidt for Governor and cast my vote for him this November.”_ **Along with Sheriff Groves, we are proud to have the support of more than 30 current and former Kansas Sheriffs. ** Friend, we must keep you and all Kansans across our great state safe. body:
We've made it this far... | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/49c264cf33e2/i-am-running-for-congress-9198822?e=356c0699dd)
---
| | | [ ](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=c817af88f9&e=356c0699dd)
---
| | | Hey there,

**We are less than one week away from the November 8 election, and we can’t slow down now. **

The push for fresh, common-sense leadership in Washington is growing — more and more folks are realizing that Scott Fitzgerald does nothing for Wisconsin families. Even part of my district that usually goes red is **currently polling dead-even.**

This is proof that the hard work that every volunteer and Democratic candidate has been putting in, meeting people where they are, and listening to their concerns is working! Folks like you and I are tired of the do-nothing politicians like Scott Fitzgerald who are only in it to line their pockets from millionaire donors and special interests, and to appease their corrupt party bosses.

**We need your support today to show Scott Fitzgerald our momentum is strong as ever and we are no longer rewarding this behavior.**[Can I count on you to help us keep up this momentum with a donation of $100, $75, $50, or even $25 today?](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=d3f4794d53&e=356c0699dd)
_If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ [Express Donate: $100](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=a9c35c77f7&e=356c0699dd) [Express Donate: $75](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=c5dffb38f3&e=356c0699dd) [Express Donate: $50](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=e744bcd6ba&e=356c0699dd) [Express Donate: $25](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=4c6a3d9811&e=356c0699dd) [Or, donate another amount](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=3013c15922&e=356c0699dd)

| While we have a winning message, we don’t have a multi-million-dollar budget funded by big-money interest groups to spend on radio & television ads, or giant billboards. And we definitely are not using taxpayer dollars to campaign like the incumbent.

**We need to kick Fitz to the curb, but we need all hands on deck through Election Day if we are going to get any closer to achieving the American Dream for all Wisconsin families.**

[Even $5 today can help us](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=1d1963a882&e=356c0699dd) keep our ads online and our field programs afloat to keep communicating directly with voters in the district who are looking for practical solutions to the problems facing us here in Wisconsin.

Your support in the final days of this campaign is critical and makes all the difference. Thank you.

Sincerely,
Mike Van Someren

clean_body: | | | Peter, In a minute, I’ll ask you to split a critical donation between URD and my campaign to flip Ohio’s open Senate seat blue. But first, let me explain why this race — and your donation — are so important today. Protecting our Democratic Senate majority is not enough. If we want to stop Mitch McConnell from abusing the filibuster, we must expand our Senate majority. And, flipping Ohio’s open Senate seat is our best chance to do just that. A new poll shows this race in a dead heat against JD Vance. Now, all we need is you. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your secure donation will go through immediately: **Donald Trump has made this race – and rural America – his top target. That’s why he attacked me during his rallies, saying Republicans “can’t take a chance” when it comes to running against me.It’s clear we’ve got the GOP running scared. My GOP opponent, JD Vance, is a multi-millionaire. Billionaire tech giant Peter Thiel has propped up JD Vance with a $10 million super PAC. He’s completely out of touch with hardworking Ohioans. Me? I’ve been on picket lines and in union halls my whole life. I’m still paying off my family’s student loans and mortgage. I’m fighting like hell to cut workers in on the deal — not prop up my wealthy friends and right-wing special interests. Peter**, I believe we can win this race.CNNranks us as one of the most likely seats to flip. But, this is on track to be one of the most competitive and expensive races. So, I’m turning to you: Let’s do this. — Tim United Rural Democrats (URD) is leading the effort to rebuild the Democratic Party in rural America. If we're going to take back our country, we need a 50-state strategy to organize in every community across the country. Will you support our network of activists on the ground as we work to rebuild our party's infrastructure and flip these areas blue?

name: Max Steiner
subject: Beware Political Violence and the Rise of the Intolerant Right
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Max Steiner for Congress 2485 Notre Dame Blvd, Ste 370 #194 Chico, CA 95928
body:
The modern GOP is morally sick | |
---
Hi friend,

It's been a few days since the attack on Paul Pelosi at his home in San Francisco. The attack was bad enough, but it's the despicable response of Republican elites that I'm going to mention today, I'm sick of seeing right-wing politicians make jokes out of an attempted political assassination. It seems like every Republican candidate from governor to senator is trying to score points with the Republican base by mocking an 82-year old crime victim -- or by spreading slanderous lies about him. It's unbelievable.

The modern GOP is morally sick -- from top to bottom, from leadership to base. There's not much else to say. I used to vote GOP occasionally (yep, I was that rare split-ticket voter), but I don't recognize any of the values that GOP candidates claimed to have as recently as 10 years ago. Maybe they were always lying. Maybe they've just been intimidated. Or maybe they've just been pushed out of party leadership because they refused to go "Full Trump" ([Pence, for all his faults, reacted to the Pelosi attack responsibly](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/dSCQfi9FLISmU3ZE3bfPhpwmY_DHMAZqFSLUrpAn-pqpaljz93xJGI0POFZe7Z4-1QDnYQzqb-97F8753gR57lvu3qN2v5sk4BJs3aSEr49mBrXcjDuClQOGSmFEkSWJc2jnRWkSborCy0mvppJPygltQra4LS-14EYtmVfiPFVvtTDOFAKqY-NgX2KQJ1KHmKgtlNFAGhiBzQUWaMQms9EusgBHwbujc7H-TpZBKawJxCNv55V1QBc96bvWPR1MQaxcjQ_nK9KFlt1yxiyeb_JjEJd9IqBF2Al7vi6oKGrQt7BkmtgqNyCwtzdHAT2oVYq6AlJ_FsMNyc0aJ97s7tpTzcYyZP6TLEPyYVL1OLCUUinrObTR95-p9JHJ117b9A5tF74Prk9h_-F5q4daFp_OZnY_FOPMZFpEtrnb1jndU8pSkCp2kcaz79fSVSB-/3qt/GOZR6JohR62hSS84_vX0hA/h0/eWWe-K4Hxy75G0aP3hDQ4LYfDUMGKWkNZx92Z5T2ixw).) I don't know why the GOP has fallen so deeply into conspiracy theories and cruelty. Honestly, I don't know how to fix it either. But I know we cannot allow a party that makes a political attack into a campaign joke to take power. November is important. Your vote is important. Your neighbors' votes are important. subject: There go my shoes
body:
| |
---
Friend, I have literally walked through my shoes. I’ve been traveling across the state nonstop, getting out and meeting Vermonters of all walks of life and telling them why our plans are the best option for Vermont.
---
|

Friend - I just stepped off the stage after debating my Trump-endorsed opponent.
I was unsurprised that my opponent launched misleading and unfounded attacks against me, but here's the truth I hope you'll take to heart: I'm proud of the work I've done here to improve the lives of the people of Connecticut, and I'll never stop fighting to do what's right for the people of this great state.
Now, with only six days left of this campaign, I'm asking you to double down with me and do everything we can to protect this seat. Remember, Mitch McConnell only needs to flip _one_ seat to take back Senate control and implement his party's plan to deny so many Americans the freedoms they cherish. The GOP is desperate to control the Senate and our nation's future. In this final week, Rick Scott and the NRSC have just dumped almost $100,000 in Connecticut to fund more of my opponent's nasty, misleading ads.
To fight back, we set a goal to raise $10,000 after the debate - and I'm counting on your support to get there. **[So please, Friend, rush $5 or whatever you can spare to help me hit this goal, win re-election, and protect Democratic control of the Senate.**](https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/blumenthal-email?refcode=jtk1291-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500)
Thank you,
Dick

body:
Dear Friend, I'm writing this letter to you today because, quite frankly, David Daleiden cannot. You may remember David as the undercover journalist who spent 30 months investigating and capturing video evidence of Planned Parenthood 's top leadership --- medical directors, national program directors, even its Senior Director of Medical Services -- **callously negotiating the harvesting and sale of aborted baby body parts.** **And now, he 's been charged with nine bogus felonies.** **[Which is why I'm asking you to make an emergency donation to the DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND right away.](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=83dd5036574649d89eb38a253cdc9466&_e=PzVXzTMrXVjdaembxBNDonO9LtwKE8UpqzcJWai-0P7eEJUm41h8ltkYMMDN1hPK8QInZREEHSZF85Dd3cGsu8rkpRWFo9-K3vfzEVt3NWEyJ3hMeo1W-aD8WLaSsInYCbMso7a_PubxCdaRnn-IzNBUAiTewvL4QjpvlcIarzkfT7Bco4n_g0jg1VE0z5q8d2o6_aazz_7mGYAu6Nf2awIZ0qNfFa3VxePhLdH6uUHZU-fk78j60M2pO7l_Ed1HUD-GgtQ6-DGtxSJsvVSxOoXkqu9PPow4Zunp_I4HsU-k1ttaEheUdAtpm561Yuj_3xH4p9pjXx-aBPWzGyOvYAU-qLqtziNEW4pbmBvD14kKbalEIr0FeBlbsMVYe-syqGX7yVqSRfbk0VRHWUqFMA%3D%3D)** You see, after David released the shocking videos of the illegal and disgusting actions of abortion executives, Kamala Harris, then California's Attorney General, colluded with Planned Parenthood to file felony charges against David... _**... Kamala Harris even ordered the California Department of Justice to raid David's home and confiscate his unpublished videos.**_ I won't sugarcoat it. If not cleared of these charges, David faces steep fines and years in state penitentiary and the consequences of being a convicted felon. While Kamala Harris --- a bought-and-paid-for ally of the abortion industry --- is sitting one heartbeat away from the presidency. That's the bad news. But here's the good news... David is fighting back. In fact, he's taking another opportunity to drag more of Planned Parenthood's dark criminality into the spotlight with two new federal lawsuits. That's right. The Thomas More Society has filed a federal civil rights lawsuit in California on behalf of David against former California Attorney General and now VicePresident Kamala Harris for prosecuting David in bad faith, twisting and perverting California's anti-eavesdropping law to persecute a citizen journalist because of his political views. Then the Thomas More Society filed a defamation (libel) lawsuit in federal court in New York against Planned Parenthood, which said David created a "fake" and "false" "smear campaign" against Planned Parenthood. In other words, the best defense is a good offense. The truth is we could no longer let David suffer such a trampling of his free speech and due process rights without a counterattack. The timing couldn't be more important. This is a critical opportunity to put Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the rest of the abortion industry on trial for conspiring to silence David in order to cover-up their illegal activities. **[That's where your emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND comes in --- by giving today you can stand with David in his hour of need.](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=83dd5036574649d89eb38a253cdc9466&_e=PzVXzTMrXVjdaembxBNDonO9LtwKE8UpqzcJWai-0P7eEJUm41h8ltkYMMDN1hPK8QInZREEHSZF85Dd3cGsu8rkpRWFo9-K3vfzEVt3NWEyJ3hMeo1W-aD8WLaSsInYCbMso7a_PubxCdaRnn-IzNBUAiTewvL4QjpvlcIarzkfT7Bco4n_g0jg1VE0z5q8d2o6_aazz_7mGYAu6Nf2awIZ0qNfFa3VxePhLdH6uUHZU-fk78j60M2pO7l_Ed1HzN0WvtTRtOWJkNUmrrXiryIyJibsvP5BzSDkLT2AvHbeP-bdz_Z_ywCVEAjOpLoJCqTa2Dk_q69aiaxVNe5b-BJZM-Cq0FwB9ZYpO0yC9kXbmbHdy1W1exAjcCyjE2h_b30o1hAGCwq2CZJq8sA_lA%3D%3D)** The reality is. . . You couldn't be there when David entered the dark underbelly of the abortion industry --- sitting across the table from abortionists haggling over the price of baby body parts with cold-blooded clarity... "I want a Lamborghini." You couldn't be there as David saw with his own eyes the preborn children who had been killed with great precision and delicacy to preserve their organs for maximum profit. You couldn't be there when the videos were released and Kamala Harris and Planned Parenthood conspired to crush David with trumped up legal charges and an armed raid on his home in which they seized laptops, hard-drives, and recording equipment. And you couldn't be there with David (our criminal defense team was there) when he voluntarily appeared in both Texas and California for booking and processing --- fingerprinted and photographed for a mugshot like a common criminal. But, now, this is the reality... there is something you can do. **[You can make an emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND to help vindicate this pro-life hero.](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=83dd5036574649d89eb38a253cdc9466&_e=PzVXzTMrXVjdaembxBNDonO9LtwKE8UpqzcJWai-0P7eEJUm41h8ltkYMMDN1hPK8QInZREEHSZF85Dd3cGsu8rkpRWFo9-K3vfzEVt3NWEyJ3hMeo1W-aD8WLaSsInYCbMso7a_PubxCdaRnn-IzNBUAiTewvL4QjpvlcIarzkfT7Bco4n_g0jg1VE0z5q8d2o6_aazz_7mGYAu6Nf2awIZ0qNfFa3VxePhLdH6uUHZU-fk78j60M2pO7l_Ed1HsLhRuzgEj0rE5LycyhtijeNIHkh9uOqxdagxDwDZFn9KVy9CR_BIWuwsM3hsefwmT6nmev2NVYInoDMXhyqlMbaJDCb6_ZnBARwC8k52_f6ijFzZHUSvEn7cOM8PxR4_rmZIYtBIN5OBNTCqn_S1Vg%3D%3D)** My name is Tom Brejcha. I'm the president and chief counsel of the Thomas More Society --- a not-for-profit law firm underwriting and helping to spearhead David's criminal defense. The Thomas More Society is proud to have defended many renowned pro-life and religious leaders in America's pro-life movement such as Joe, Ann, and Eric Scheidler, the Pro-Life Action League, Shawn Carney and 40 Days for Life, Abby Johnson, the Susan B. Anthony List, David Bereit, Lila Rose and Live Action, Students for Life, Sidewalk Advocates for Life, Created Equal, former Kansas Attorney General Phill Kline, the March for Life, and many more. Because when dark forces like Planned Parenthood unleash their full might to legally, financially, and personally destroy our clients --- **we fight back.** I have to tell you, despite all that David is facing, his spirits remain high. Of course, I've never known anyone in this kind of position who didn't feel an empty pit in his stomach. But David's not giving up. His willingness to fight back is a true profile in Pro-Life courage. Now I'll get right down to it... **We anticipate David's legal defense will cost us more than $6 million. That's right, SIX MILLION DOLLARS.** In addition to the criminal case and the new federal civil rights and defamation lawsuits, we're currently representing David in THREE other cases.
* The civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood where we are appealing the jury's verdict, along with the judge's order permanently banning David from doing any more undercover journalism against Planned Parenthood. Recently, we posted a $700,000 appeal bond to keep Planned Parenthood's nasty collection agents from harassing him with collection agents and even seizing his belongings. We're fighting back, but we'll need your help.

* The civil lawsuit brought by the National Abortion Federation and the "gag order" injunction that still prohibits David from releasing any more of his video evidence exposing Planned Parenthood's illegal fetal tissue business. And now, in light of the Planned Parenthood civil lawsuit, NAF has moved for summary judgment - they want a ruling against David without a trial at all!

* And finally, the civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood personnel in federal court in Seattle, where we just achieved a victory for a second time on appeal, but it appears we may need at least a third victory on appeal before this case ends.

That's why David needs your financial support today. **[And that's why I'm praying you will donate $35 or more to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND right away.](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=83dd5036574649d89eb38a253cdc9466&_e=PzVXzTMrXVjdaembxBNDonO9LtwKE8UpqzcJWai-0P7eEJUm41h8ltkYMMDN1hPK8QInZREEHSZF85Dd3cGsu8rkpRWFo9-K3vfzEVt3NWEyJ3hMeo1W-aD8WLaSsInYCbMso7a_PubxCdaRnn-IzNBUAiTewvL4QjpvlcIarzkfT7Bco4n_g0jg1VE0z5q8d2o6_aazz_7mGYAu6Nf2awIZ0qNfFa3VxePhLdH6uUHZU-fk78j60M2pO7l_Ed1HiW9zxOc3mckeOWliyhYqKPA-wmPjxVWi7YIZVtlEdO5JzkUqw3lM2FWTcqAP5uHf5VNvW95N3trfwUtpU7yyf6fN5vuVaaDlCJPhpRwX6OFEnpjrFw1tjaHKvO0OuGmKZmluBcNDbrOjbIYhhmOU-A%3D%3D)** I won't guess how much you're able to send today. Whether it's $35, $50, $75, $125, $250, $500, $1,000 or more... ... I will only say that time is of the essence. So I do ask that you make your donation as soon as you can. **This truly is a "David versus Goliath" type of battle --- with Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the radical left arrayed against our "David."** It's a grave injustice that David is the one being hit with felony charges and massive civil penalties while Planned Parenthood (so far, at least) has gone unpunished. By clearing David of these charges... you and I can allow him to continue with his incredibly important lifesaving work. Remember, over 12 million people on YouTube alone watched the shocking footage he captured. Since that time, 26 states --- over half the country -- have moved to strip Planned Parenthood of taxpayer funding. It's no wonder Planned Parenthood and their allies want to destroy David. They'd love to see him rotting away in penitentiary rather than exposing their criminal and inhumane activities. You and I cannot let that happen. **[So please don't delay. Donate $35, $50, $100, or more to stand with David Daleiden today.](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=83dd5036574649d89eb38a253cdc9466&_e=PzVXzTMrXVjdaembxBNDonO9LtwKE8UpqzcJWai-0P7eEJUm41h8ltkYMMDN1hPK8QInZREEHSZF85Dd3cGsu8rkpRWFo9-K3vfzEVt3NWEyJ3hMeo1W-aD8WLaSsInYCbMso7a_PubxCdaRnn-IzNBUAiTewvL4QjpvlcIarzkfT7Bco4n_g0jg1VE0z5q8d2o6_aazz_7mGYAu6Nf2awIZ0qNfFa3VxePhLdH6uUHZU-fk78j60M2pO7l_Ed1HMbu98rW3aTPozCXyxdewfMT7jA2ryQRnaF52yAjwjC6FqW_Ntb9j3Xcx3A10oHkZL6TWPnyLI_-dZzCmKgVYIMdwQR9ySGZcVwnUROKkFo-CEtsKAeD8e4DFvy7aw2yN2Th_izhnQRckWqqOJhNjRw%3D%3D)** I've asked my staff to let me know as soon as we get it so I can let David know that you're standing with him. I know he'll be deeply touched by your generous support. May God Bless You, Tom Brejcha

clean_body: Dear Friend, I'm writing this letter to you today because, quite frankly, David Daleiden cannot. You may remember David as the undercover journalist who spent 30 months investigating and capturing video evidence of Planned Parenthood 's top leadership --- medical directors, national program directors, even its Senior Director of Medical Services -- callously negotiating the harvesting and sale of aborted baby body parts. And now, he 's been charged with nine bogus felonies. You see, after David released the shocking videos of the illegal and disgusting actions of abortion executives, Kamala Harris, then California's Attorney General, colluded with Planned Parenthood to file felony charges against David... ... Kamala Harris even ordered the California Department of Justice to raid David's home and confiscate his unpublished videos. I won't sugarcoat it. If not cleared of these charges, David faces steep fines and years in state penitentiary and the consequences of being a convicted felon. While Kamala Harris --- a bought-and-paid-for ally of the abortion industry --- is sitting one heartbeat away from the presidency. That's the bad news. But here's the good news... David is fighting back. In fact, he's taking another opportunity to drag more of Planned Parenthood's dark criminality into the spotlight with two new federal lawsuits. That's right. The Thomas More Society has filed a federal civil rights lawsuit in California on behalf of David against former California Attorney General and now VicePresident Kamala Harris for prosecuting David in bad faith, twisting and perverting California's anti-eavesdropping law to persecute a citizen journalist because of his political views. Then the Thomas More Society filed a defamation (libel) lawsuit in federal court in New York against Planned Parenthood, which said David created a "fake" and "false" "smear campaign" against Planned Parenthood. In other words, the best defense is a good offense. The truth is we could no longer let David suffer such a trampling of his free speech and due process rights without a counterattack. The timing couldn't be more important. This is a critical opportunity to put Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the rest of the abortion industry on trial for conspiring to silence David in order to cover-up their illegal activities. The reality is. . . You couldn't be there when David entered the dark underbelly of the abortion industry --- sitting across the table from abortionists haggling over the price of baby body parts with cold-blooded clarity... "I want a Lamborghini." You couldn't be there as David saw with his own eyes the preborn children who had been killed with great precision and delicacy to preserve their organs for maximum profit. You couldn't be there when the videos were released and Kamala Harris and Planned Parenthood conspired to crush David with trumped up legal charges and an armed raid on his home in which they seized laptops, hard-drives, and recording equipment. And you couldn't be there with David (our criminal defense team was there) when he voluntarily appeared in both Texas and California for booking and processing --- fingerprinted and photographed for a mugshot like a common criminal. But, now, this is the reality... there is something you can do. My name is Tom Brejcha. I'm the president and chief counsel of the Thomas More Society --- a not-for-profit law firm underwriting and helping to spearhead David's criminal defense. The Thomas More Society is proud to have defended many renowned pro-life and religious leaders in America's pro-life movement such as Joe, Ann, and Eric Scheidler, the Pro-Life Action League, Shawn Carney and 40 Days for Life, Abby Johnson, the Susan B. Anthony List, David Bereit, Lila Rose and Live Action, Students for Life, Sidewalk Advocates for Life, Created Equal, former Kansas Attorney General Phill Kline, the March for Life, and many more. Because when dark forces like Planned Parenthood unleash their full might to legally, financially, and personally destroy our clients --- we fight back. I have to tell you, despite all that David is facing, his spirits remain high. Of course, I've never known anyone in this kind of position who didn't feel an empty pit in his stomach. But David's not giving up. His willingness to fight back is a true profile in Pro-Life courage. Now I'll get right down to it... We anticipate David's legal defense will cost us more than $6 million. That's right, SIX MILLION DOLLARS. In addition to the criminal case and the new federal civil rights and defamation lawsuits, we're currently representing David in THREE other cases. The civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood where we are appealing the jury's verdict, along with the judge's order permanently banning David from doing any more undercover journalism against Planned Parenthood. Recently, we posted a $700,000 appeal bond to keep Planned Parenthood's nasty collection agents from harassing him with collection agents and even seizing his belongings. We're fighting back, but we'll need your help. The civil lawsuit brought by the National Abortion Federation and the "gag order" injunction that still prohibits David from releasing any more of his video evidence exposing Planned Parenthood's illegal fetal tissue business. And now, in light of the Planned Parenthood civil lawsuit, NAF has moved for summary judgment - they want a ruling against David without a trial at all! And finally, the civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood personnel in federal court in Seattle, where we just achieved a victory for a second time on appeal, but it appears we may need at least a third victory on appeal before this case ends. That's why David needs your financial support today. I won't guess how much you're able to send today. Whether it's $35, $50, $75, $125, $250, $500, $1,000 or more... ... I will only say that time is of the essence. So I do ask that you make your donation as soon as you can. This truly is a "David versus Goliath" type of battle --- with Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the radical left arrayed against our "David." It's a grave injustice that David is the one being hit with felony charges and massive civil penalties while Planned Parenthood (so far, at least) has gone unpunished. By clearing David of these charges... you and I can allow him to continue with his incredibly important lifesaving work. Remember, over 12 million people on YouTube alone watched the shocking footage he captured. Since that time, 26 states --- over half the country -- have moved to strip Planned Parenthood of taxpayer funding. It's no wonder Planned Parenthood and their allies want to destroy David. They'd love to see him rotting away in penitentiary rather than exposing their criminal and inhumane activities. You and I cannot let that happen. I've asked my staff to let me know as soon as we get it so I can let David know that you're standing with him. I know he'll be deeply touched by your generous support. May God Bless You, Tom Brejcha President & Chief Counsel P.S. Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and their allies want to destroy David. They'd love to see him rotting away in penitentiary rather than exposing their criminal, ghoulish activities. You and I cannot let that happen. #
Peter,
We’re down to the wire now, and we have less than ideal news to share. We’ve been monitoring our fundraising numbers since our October end-of-month deadline closed, but we can’t avoid it any longer.
**We did NOT reach our $75,000 goal** , and we urgently need to make up the difference. In the spirit of transparency, we’re going to share that we’re still just about $11,000 short:
[](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/21635?refcode=em20221102-1794&t=1&akid=1794%2E420207%2Ew7k5se)
---
We’re extending our deadline for the next 48 hours and we need all hands on deck. [**Peter, will you dig deep and send us a donation of $3 or whatever you can afford to help us finally reach our goal of $75,000 before it’s too late?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/21635?refcode=em20221102-1794&t=2&akid=1794%2E420207%2Ew7k5se)
**[Contribute](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/21635?refcode=em20221102-1794&t=21&akid=1794%2E420207%2Ew7k5se)**

So we’re determined to do everything we can to reach this goal and turn things around, because **the stakes are simply too high for us to fall behind now.**

subject: A personal note in the final stretch
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Barrier to Entry PAC
body:
Hi Friends, I admit this email is long but hoping you'll take the time to read it all.
| | | [](https://barriertoentrypac.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb795e0b9271d112fbc5c1bd8&id=5ad157d8c6&e=007b353608)
---
Dear Peter,

Heads up — this is a lengthy personal email, but you’re so important to this work that I hope you’ll take a moment to read it all.

As we kick off November, I’ve been reflecting. It is hard for me to believe that we are in the final stage of the 2022 Election Cycle, our first cycle as an organization, two years in the making.

In some ways it feels like just yesterday that Megan and I were back and forth on phone calls, trying to get things up and running.

**We started with a simple mission: to support ordinary, working, underpaid, and low-income people who want to run for office on progressive platforms.

** Barrier To Entry PAC’s founding team of campaign professionals saw over and over, from campaign to campaign, how our electoral system favors the wealthy. Our team saw the damage it causes to our democracy when only the rich have the ability to run for office. We decided we might as well try to do something about it.

As we launched B/E PAC, we used data to tell this story, educate our allies, and define our mission. When we looked into campaign finance data publicly available on FEC.gov and saw the numbers in front of us, it felt like someone punched me in the stomach.

* In May 2021, the average amount of money a federal candidate gives to their own campaign is **$637,246.33.**
* This reminded me of an article I read that had said the average American would not know where to find $400 or more if they found themselves in an unexpected financial emergency.

**__So you tell me, who can run for office in this country?__**

The answer is very, very few people. And the sacrifice is enormous for those who run without personal wealth.

**We knew we had our work cut out for us: breaking socioeconomic barriers that keep regular working-class candidates from running for office is not for the faint of heart.**

With your help, we raised over $85,000 this cycle between Barrier To Entry PAC and its sister org, Pay Your Interns PAC, which we use to direct funds to support interns and staff on these campaigns.

**_Now, you probably want to know: Where did all your money go?_** We provided startup funds to help candidates running for local office on leftist platforms. We hustled to use the seed funding to produce a more sustainable income stream with a strong email fundraising program and by hosting more traditional grassroots events. We paid for mailers, digital ads, phonebanking, organizing, texting — all so our candidates could reach their voters and compete with their wealthy well-connected opponents. We paid for our candidates to staff up their campaigns with talented interns looking to enter politics. We paid for volunteer recruitment, campaign materials, office supplies, and more.

**This money, the money YOU gave us, allowed us to do BIG things. Every single grassroots donation that we raised has made a difference. We have literally survived off of small dollar gifts.**[**And it’s not too late for you to have an impact before the 2022 cycle ends — pitch in here right now to be a part of the change.

**](https://barriertoentrypac.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb795e0b9271d112fbc5c1bd8&id=6113f69813&e=007b353608) Everything we do here is a team effort. So when we say our movement is “people-powered”, we truly mean it. While our candidates push for systemic change from the inside to improve the lives of everyday people, our grassroots army digs in deep too, helping to forge the path for these trailblazers.

There are very real people behind these emails doing this work. To Megan and Jessi and Elizabeth and Jessica and Annie and EJ and Mel and Liz and Frances and Scott and Grace and Michelle and Jen — and everyone who contributed their hard work and time to B/E — **_thank you._** To all of our partners — like Mike, Etana, and Heather at the IUE-CWA union, one of our largest contributors — **_thank you.

_** **_And of course, to our endorsed candidates, who are carefully selected: Thank you for running, and thank you for letting us be a part of it._**

Their names are: Jessica Mason. Shaquana Boykin. Peter Schwartzman. Ed Gainey. Jared Grandy. Kimi Cole. Shenise Turner-Sloss. Angelina Jackson. Daniel Ortiz. Joe Thompson. Bria Bennett. Willie Roberts. **_Thank you._**

These changemakers stand for universal healthcare. They’re for a Green New Deal. They’re bold. They’re diverse. Some are parents, some are students, some are Navy veterans, some are union workers. They’re young at heart. They’re cool. They’re funny. They’re normal people. They reflect and represent their communities. They lead and they steer, while we fuel the engine.

**_We have so much to be proud of, but the election cycle is not over just yet._** We’ve still got so much on the line, particularly in Montgomery County, Ohio, where we are working to elect Angelina Jackson for Judge of Common Pleas. When elected, she will be the only Black woman sitting on a bench that is **90% white.**

Montgomery County is a crucial area to protect abortion access in Ohio. As a judge, Angie will preside over abortion and abortion related crimes in the same area where the Kettering clinic provides critical care to the region— the same clinic where the 10 year old was turned away. **_Yeah, that clinic.

_** *Deep breath*

So yes, there’s a lot at stake. And we need to finish this cycle strong. You guys, we can do this. We’ve been doing it. Let’s push hard in these final days to get Angie elected for the people of Montgomery County. Let’s talk to every possible voter. Let’s do it for that 10 year old. Let’s do it for people who deserve a fair trial. Let’s do everything we can, knowing that at this moment in time, every single one of us is being called to step up.

[**At Barrier To Entry PAC, our candidates run to win. We need your help fueling this people-powered work. So please, would you consider making a contribution right now to help our candidates defeat the GOP’s far-right agenda in next week’s critical election?/strong>**](https://barriertoentrypac.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb795e0b9271d112fbc5c1bd8&id=f1d5534022&e=007b353608)

You might be wondering why you should care, potentially being far away from some of these races. So before I let you go, I want to leave you with one question, which I feel really sums up our philosophy: **_If injustice anywhere is injustice everywhere, then could the inverse be just as true?

_** At Barrier To Entry PAC, we believe that injustice anywhere is injustice everywhere. We also believe that justice, meaningful justice anywhere, is justice everywhere. Justice is justice is justice, and light is light is light. That’s the spirit at the heart of this work.

[**With that question in mind, we’re coming to you again in this final stretch hoping that you’ll step up: Please, friends,will you chip in $27 or any amount today to join us in the fight for justice and help us build a government that works for real everyday working-class people? Donate now to get us across the finish line in this PIVOTAL FINAL WEEK >>**](https://barriertoentrypac.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb795e0b9271d112fbc5c1bd8&id=d6f6b415e1&e=007b353608)

_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ **______[CHIP IN $27 →](https://barriertoentrypac.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb795e0b9271d112fbc5c1bd8&id=6bc4446565&e=007b353608)** **______[GIVE ANOTHER AMOUNT](https://barriertoentrypac.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb795e0b9271d112fbc5c1bd8&id=44fb68d24b&e=007b353608)** Let there be more justice, more light, and more barriers broken.

Thanks for being here with us,
**_\-- Eden
_** (Founder & CEO of Barrier to Entry PAC)

clean_body: Hi Friends, I admit this email is long but hoping you'll take the time to read it all. | | | Dear Peter, Heads up — this is a lengthy personal email, but you’re so important to this work that I hope you’ll take a moment to read it all. As we kick off November, I’ve been reflecting. It is hard for me to believe that we are in the final stage of the 2022 Election Cycle, our first cycle as an organization, two years in the making. In some ways it feels like just yesterday that Megan and I were back and forth on phone calls, trying to get things up and running. We started with a simple mission: to support ordinary, working, underpaid, and low-income people who want to run for office on progressive platforms. Barrier To Entry PAC’s founding team of campaign professionals saw over and over, from campaign to campaign, how our electoral system favors the wealthy. Our team saw the damage it causes to our democracy when only the rich have the ability to run for office. We decided we might as well try to do something about it. As we launched B/E PAC, we used data to tell this story, educate our allies, and define our mission. When we looked into campaign finance data publicly available on FEC.gov and saw the numbers in front of us, it felt like someone punched me in the stomach. In May 2021, the average amount of money a federal candidate gives to their own campaign is $637,246.33. This reminded me of an article I read that had said the average American would not know where to find $400 or more if they found themselves in an unexpected financial emergency. So you tell me, who can run for office in this country? The answer is very, very few people. And the sacrifice is enormous for those who run without personal wealth. We knew we had our work cut out for us: breaking socioeconomic barriers that keep regular working-class candidates from running for office is not for the faint of heart. With your help, we raised over $85,000 this cycle between Barrier To Entry PAC and its sister org, Pay Your Interns PAC, which we use to direct funds to support interns and staff on these campaigns. Now, you probably want to know: Where did all your money go? We provided startup funds to help candidates running for local office on leftist platforms. We hustled to use the seed funding to produce a more sustainable income stream with a strong email fundraising program and by hosting more traditional grassroots events. We paid for mailers, digital ads, phonebanking, organizing, texting — all so our candidates could reach their voters and compete with their wealthy well-connected opponents. We paid for our candidates to staff up their campaigns with talented interns looking to enter politics. We paid for volunteer recruitment, campaign materials, office supplies, and more. This money, the money YOU gave us, allowed us to do BIG things. Every single grassroots donation that we raised has made a difference. We have literally survived off of small dollar gifts. Everything we do here is a team effort. So when we say our movement is “people-powered”, we truly mean it. While our candidates push for systemic change from the inside to improve the lives of everyday people, our grassroots army digs in deep too, helping to forge the path for these trailblazers. There are very real people behind these emails doing this work. To Megan and Jessi and Elizabeth and Jessica and Annie and EJ and Mel and Liz and Frances and Scott and Grace and Michelle and Jen — and everyone who contributed their hard work and time to B/E — thank you. To all of our partners — like Mike, Etana, and Heather at the IUE-CWA union, one of our largest contributors — thank you. And of course, to our endorsed candidates, who are carefully selected: Thank you for running, and thank you for letting us be a part of it. Their names are: Jessica Mason. Shaquana Boykin. Peter Schwartzman. Ed Gainey. Jared Grandy. Kimi Cole. Shenise Turner-Sloss. Angelina Jackson. Daniel Ortiz. Joe Thompson. Bria Bennett. Willie Roberts. Thank you. These changemakers stand for universal healthcare. They’re for a Green New Deal. They’re bold. They’re diverse. Some are parents, some are students, some are Navy veterans, some are union workers. They’re young at heart. They’re cool. They’re funny. They’re normal people. They reflect and represent their communities. They lead and they steer, while we fuel the engine. We have so much to be proud of, but the election cycle is not over just yet. We’ve still got so much on the line, particularly in Montgomery County, Ohio, where we are working to elect Angelina Jackson for Judge of Common Pleas. When elected, she will be the only Black woman sitting on a bench that is 90% white. Montgomery County is a crucial area to protect abortion access in Ohio. As a judge, Angie will preside over abortion and abortion related crimes in the same area where the Kettering clinic provides critical care to the region— the same clinic where the 10 year old was turned away. Yeah, that clinic. Deep breath So yes, there’s a lot at stake. And we need to finish this cycle strong. You guys, we can do this. We’ve been doing it. Let’s push hard in these final days to get Angie elected for the people of Montgomery County. Let’s talk to every possible voter. Let’s do it for that 10 year old. Let’s do it for people who deserve a fair trial. Let’s do everything we can, knowing that at this moment in time, every single one of us is being called to step up. You might be wondering why you should care, potentially being far away from some of these races. So before I let you go, I want to leave you with one question, which I feel really sums up our philosophy: If injustice anywhere is injustice everywhere, then could the inverse be just as true? At Barrier To Entry PAC, we believe that injustice anywhere is injustice everywhere. We also believe that justice, meaningful justice anywhere, is justice everywhere. Justice is justice is justice, and light is light is light. That’s the spirit at the heart of this work. If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: ____ __ Let there be more justice, more light, and more barriers broken. Thanks for being here with us, \-- Eden (Founder & CEO of Barrier to Entry PAC) ********************** ************************************EXPRESS DONATE to Barrier to Entry PAC: If you've stored payment info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: | ************************************ "" | ************************************ "" | ************************************ "" | ************************************ "" ---|---|---|--- BARRIER TO ENTRY PAC is proudly 100% women owned and operated — by women of color, queer women, progressive women — who are committed to achieving social change through inclusive public leadership. | | It has not been an easy year for my family to navigate everything thrown in our path, and even through the demanding schedule of the campaign, I could always call on my dad to help me navigate the highs and lows of life. He's still the same dad he always has been; there to provide advice, support, a listening ear, and the occasional medical and parental advice. Now, just days out from the election, I find myself excited and incredibly proud of what my father has been able to accomplish. Aside from a war chest and a huge political party apparatus, he has what should be deemed more important in the political sphere:
* He has thousands of people who met him at one or more of his events.
* He has thousands of emails he has responded to, providing his position on vital issues from people in the district.
* He has thousands of phone calls that he has made to people with questions, thoughts, wonderings, or ideas to share.
* He has stayed in countless hotels throughout the district and driven many miles, constantly texting the family when he arrives home late at night after campaign events.
* He has personally helped craft just about every part of the campaign.
* And, what he probably cares about the most, he has a proud family - proud of his conduct throughout the campaign. We love him for his passion and dedication.

I am excited to be back in my hometown of Marquette for election day. I will be there with my daughter, and we will be helping out with the campaign however we can in those final days. She's excited to support Grandpa Bob, and I am proud to be knocking on doors for my dad. He is the type of person I would want to represent my family and me, not because he is my dad, but because he has shown he knows what it means to be a leader. He is dedicated to service and true representation. Can we count on your support to carry us to the finish line? We need to continue our fundraising momentum to complete the final projects of the campaign. Thank you!
\- Peter Lorinser

#
This is Mark Ruffalo. Like you, I've worked for years to fight climate change.
I'll never forget the many times in 2021 and 2022 that climate legislation FAILED in the Senate because of Joe Manchin and Kyrsten Sinema's support for the anti-democratic filibuster. We finally passed something big, but it only works if it is a first step.
**To save our planet and build a green economy for our kids, we need to elect two more Democratic Senators and bust the filibuster.**
[**I'm asking you to donate to Mandela Barnes' final Get Out The Vote efforts in Wisconsin — so Democrats pick up this Senate seat and Ron Johnson is nowhere near power.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mandela-em-nov22.Jaf-Cy&refcode=em221102-3-gm-p12&t=1&akid=3948%2E196590%2Etmv9Sg)
Expanding the Senate majority is key to eliminating the filibuster and passing pro-democracy reforms. And protecting abortion access and fighting climate change.
If Mitch McConnell becomes Majority Leader, it would make me angry. And Ron Johnson is a MAGA extremist endorsed by Trump.
**He would ban abortion nationally, going further than the Supreme Court did.**
**He would block any attempt to fight climate change, dooming us all.**
**He would block raising the minimum wage above the current $7.25 an hour.**
**He would cut Social Security, while giving tax cuts to the rich.**
**He would block any attempt to restore voting rights and protect democracy.**
**And that's separate from Ron Johnson trying to block the peaceful transfer of power on January 6.**
[**I'm asking you to donate to Mandela Barnes' final Get Out The Vote efforts in Wisconsin — so Democrats pick up this Senate seat and Ron Johnson is nowhere near power.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mandela-em-nov22.Jaf-Cy&refcode=em221102-3-gm-p12&t=2&akid=3948%2E196590%2Etmv9Sg)
Thank you, and let's be all in for this final push.
Mark Ruffalo

Ayoub El-Khazzani, an ISIS terrorist emerged from the bathroom, bare-chested and armed with a box cutter, an assault rifle, a jar of gasoline, and 270 rounds of ammunition attempted to take over and **kill more than 500 passengers.**

Right now, our homeland is in danger. Not from radical Islamic terrorists, but radical Democrats who want to fundamentally alter the fabric of this GREAT nation. Leftist legislation is assaulting our Nation, our communities, and the American Dream.

Right now, Democrats are...
* Opening and destroying our borders. They are granting dangerous amnesty that have and will continue to flood every corner of America.

"We are here today to address a pattern of voter suppression in Tennessee, a pattern of disenfranchising voters, and particularly voters in marginalized communities.

clean_body: we have an incredible opportunity to make real progress on gun violence prevention | | | Friend – it's always hard to tell this story. My 14-year-old daughter Jaime was a bright girl with a beautiful future ahead of her – but her life was cut tragically short when she was brutally murdered during the shooting at Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School in Parkland, Florida. After she was killed, Marco Rubio lied to my face and to every other Parkland family. He said he’d try to stop gun violence, but in the four years since my daughter's death, Marco Rubio has voted against every single bill that could have prevented another parent from losing a child to gun violence like I have. It makes me sick to my stomach to think about his cowardice, friend. = Now, we have an incredible opportunity to make real progress on gun violence prevention by replacing Marco Rubio with Democrat Val Demings – but with only six days until the election and Floridians already voting, polls still show this race is tied. = It's not an exaggeration to call this the single most important race on Nov. 8: Political experts say that Senate control will likely come down to this race in Florida – which means that we can ONLY pass lifesaving gun violence prevention measures IF Val Demings wins and expands our Senate majority. I'm reaching out asking you for a donation, but it's not just about a fundraising deadline: This is about the people we can save. This is our one chance to flip Florida blue, expand our Democratic Senate majority and pass lifesaving legislation to end gun violence – and the polls prove that Val Demings can win. But it's not going to be easy to overcome Marco Rubio's massive fundraising war chest after the gun lobby has given him over $3 million. Val Demings can only win this race if she reaches her fundraising goal before her deadline at midnight tonight – so I'm reaching out personally to ask every person on this email list to give what they can and join me in the fight against gun violence. = I can never get my Jaime back, but helping changemakers like Val Demings – a leader who has passed life-saving gun safety legislation – gives me the purpose I've needed since Jaime's murder. **MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

name: Nick Rathod, Beto for Texas
subject: It’s our last chance to fund TV ads
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Beto for Texas
body:
Tomorrow at 5pm ET is the banking cutoff to wire money out for TV ads.
#
Hi, I’ll be quick. Yes, we’re going to ask you for money but I want to be upfront about why it’s so important right now:
1. **Greg Abbott has outspent us on TV and radio ads 2.5-to-1.** We’ve still kept this a tight race thanks to all of our amazing volunteers and grassroots donors.
2. **Tomorrow at 5pm ET is the banking cutoff to wire money out for funding TV ads.** After that, the rest of our resources will need to be spent elsewhere.
3. **We are trying to raise $450,000 TODAY to meet our TV ad budget.** But, we’re currently not on track to hit that goal.

[**Will you rush a $3 donation to Beto right now before the final deadline for television advertising hits? We need a lot of people to step up if we’re going to hit the $450,000 goal we need to not cut back on our ads.**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20221102-3.MNwfxA&refcode=ema20221102-215603&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=215603%2E444211%2EkrQpJ6)
**[Rush a $3 Donation »](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20221102-3.MNwfxA&refcode=ema20221102-215603&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=215603%2E444211%2EkrQpJ6)**
Early voting has already started, but most of the vote isn’t in. Three recent polls show us neck-and-neck with Abbott, but we can’t afford to be outspent so heavily on the airwaves. Not when so many Texas voters usually make up their minds about their vote near the end of the election.
Thanks for helping us out today.
Nick Rathod
Campaign Manager, Beto for Texas

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

Hi everybody — this is Ted Danson from Cheers, Becker, and a few other shows and films over the years.
I’ll keep this pretty short: [**Mark Kelly needs our help. If you can afford it, a $ASK donation will make a big difference.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-nov22.ftVLpg&refcode=em221102-3-7&t=2&akid=4635%2E6688874%2Emdgq7l) But as a bonus, I’ve got a story for you if you can stick around for a minute.
I guess I’ve had an activist streak ever since I was a kid. My dad was a scientist at Northern Arizona University, and one of his colleagues was a geologist named Bill Breed. Arizona is spectacularly beautiful, and Bill thought there were too many billboards ruining the scenery. So he’d take a friend and me out in his little Volkswagen, maybe 10 or 11 o’clock at night, and we’d go chop them down. Took down quite a few, actually.
Eventually my dad found out though, because we left up a billboard for a museum. Specifically, the museum at NAU.
Now, to be clear, I don’t want anyone going out and chopping down billboards. This was a story, not advice. There are other ways to make a difference, and most of them do not involve axes.
In fact, I know of a very, very good way. So, once more:

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

clean_body: We need to pick up the pace ASAP or this race could be over... | | Fellow American, I wouldn’t be reaching out to you so frantically if this wasn’t a dire situation ... but my Democrat-endorsed opponent is outraising my campaign and we’re less than two weeks away from Election Day. Now is not the time to fall behind - too much is at stake in this election for us to lose. I called my team and asked them what I can do to pick up the pace. Their response? REACH OUT TO YOU, Fellow American. If I win – Republicans will win back the Senate majority. If I lose - well, you know. We can’t let that happen. The Democrats are determined to win in Utah. Chuck Schumer knows a WIN here is the ONLY WAY the left can hold their majority. My campaign is being outraised and time is running out before Election Day. This is the time when critical ad placements are made and without money in the bank - my opponent will be able to reach more voters at a crucial stage in this race. Help me win and help Republicans take back the Senate majority. I’m counting on hearing from you. For America, Mike Lee MEET MIKE: | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property. After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court. Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah. | | | ---|---|--- | Paid for by Friends of Mike Lee, Inc. PO Box 1537 Salt Lake City, UT 84110

| | | Hello,

I’m honored that people from all over Montana think I'm a good fit to be their next Congressperson. They see that**Matt Rosendale is just not cutting it** , and they want a change. I'm ready to be that change.

Read some recent letters to the editor.
---
| | "Penny Ronning, a former City Council member from Billings, is smart, hardworking and ready to represent our Congressional district with professionalism, decency and a "get it done" attitude. Vote Ronning on Nov. 8!" - John Ilgenfritz, [Helena Independent Record](https://pennyronning.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05c2d51066158a4f5219d9967&id=92f82b39c8&e=2f4ec52c5e)
---
| | "Women's rights are on the ballot this Nov. 8 with a measure that will profoundly deny our abilities to live a life of human dignity, human rights, bodily autonomy and economic security. This is why we must elect women's human rights champions to defend our rights." \- President of Montana NOW Jan Strout[,](http://) [Billings Gazette](https://pennyronning.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05c2d51066158a4f5219d9967&id=3006d92c45&e=2f4ec52c5e)
---
| | "What we need in D.C. is a person who will carry out real Montana values and goals for us. That person is Penny Ronning. Met her, visited with her, and do believe her to be honest and dedicated." \- Norma J. Sherman, [Glendive Ranger Review](https://pennyronning.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05c2d51066158a4f5219d9967&id=071515130f&e=2f4ec52c5e)
---
| | "Her credentials on public safety include national recognition by the director of the Federal Bureau of Investigation by forging a community partnership with local, state, and federal law enforcement agencies to end human trafficking, a serious problem in our region, as elsewhere." -Char of the Yellowstone County Democrats Central Committee Becky Riedl, [Billings Gazette](https://pennyronning.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05c2d51066158a4f5219d9967&id=b2b17881d4&e=2f4ec52c5e)
---
| | "Penny's in-depth policy knowledge, experience with writing and working to pass legislation in Montana, and service as a non-partisan elected official on the Billings City Council make her the perfect replacement for a do-nothing embarrassment like Rosendale. I am casting my vote for Penny Ronning, and urge you to learn more about her qualifications and platform before making a voting decision." \- Linda Beischel, [Helen](https://pennyronning.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05c2d51066158a4f5219d9967&id=56f07146e2&e=2f4ec52c5e)[a Independent Record](https://pennyronning.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05c2d51066158a4f5219d9967&id=f0206dd2b2&e=2f4ec52c5e)

| I've proven from my debates to my town halls and campaigning that I have what it takes to do this job successfully. My whole life has been spent in Montana and I'm dedicated to making it the best place it can be for us all.

**I've demonstrated as a former Billings Councilmember and a Montanan that I have what it takes to lead this great state.** I was raised here and I know what every day Montanans need for themselves and their families. I will protect our right to privacy, access to public lands, retirement benefits like social security, improve our economy, and more.

They see thatMatt Rosendale is just not cutting it , and they want a change. I'm ready to be that change. Read some recent letters to the editor. | | "Penny Ronning, a former City Council member from Billings, is smart, hardworking and ready to represent our Congressional district with professionalism, decency and a "get it done" attitude. Vote Ronning on Nov. 8!" - John Ilgenfritz, | | "Women's rights are on the ballot this Nov. 8 with a measure that will profoundly deny our abilities to live a life of human dignity, human rights, bodily autonomy and economic security. This is why we must elect women's human rights champions to defend our rights." \- President of Montana NOW Jan Strouthttp:// | | "What we need in D.C. is a person who will carry out real Montana values and goals for us. Sherman, | | "Her credentials on public safety include national recognition by the director of the Federal Bureau of Investigation by forging a community partnership with local, state, and federal law enforcement agencies to end human trafficking, a serious problem in our region, as elsewhere." -Char of the Yellowstone County Democrats Central Committee Becky Riedl, | | "Penny's in-depth policy knowledge, experience with writing and working to pass legislation in Montana, and service as a non-partisan elected official on the Billings City Council make her the perfect replacement for a do-nothing embarrassment like Rosendale. Besides shattering a U.S. record for apprehending nearly 2.4 million illegal immigrants along the Mexican border in fiscal year 2022, Border Patrol agents arrested hundreds of gang members—mostly from the famously violent Mara Salvatrucha (MS-13)—and dozens of people on the national terrorist watchlist. Federal agents also confiscated thousands of pounds of drugs, mainly methamphetamine, according to government figures released by Customs and Border Protection (CBP) just days ago. The startling year-end (fiscal years run from October to September) stats depict a chaotic Mexican border region rife with lawlessness that is inevitably seeping north.

Now, phony politicians run for office to gain power and influence for themselves.

I'm running for Congress because I want to go back to the way things used to be.

****[SEND ELI INSTEAD](http://links.mwaltzforcongress.com/u/click?_t=d89142ed55974e2696402eb6b29e4daf&_m=f753a90df4ba4dd69bb080e4714f5a09&_e=-BzPPmcR8VKxbjFqpERtHEW43yoWQeIRqVO2s5Ik0mSIQrRVAQVh5LCYspunKsI9O0nlB_tOeQ4SjntAYQAXUHtEkfcCfffcXfVvqBorcMnISciUvW591IraPE893idXOcmoud87iasYLko6DDpd1Z2aZr4mYp6Xdj5i_Nztv9v-bav_3N-j13k4ewWLkTghu4zwLLBTRNv2rMrmwR_69i0W_SwmPlO9pLwaG58LSkymLmkJ2AIm9BxcIzxSi22a)****

****[SEND THIS SEAL](http://links.mwaltzforcongress.com/u/click?_t=d89142ed55974e2696402eb6b29e4daf&_m=f753a90df4ba4dd69bb080e4714f5a09&_e=-BzPPmcR8VKxbjFqpERtHEW43yoWQeIRqVO2s5Ik0mSIQrRVAQVh5LCYspunKsI9O0nlB_tOeQ4SjntAYQAXUHtEkfcCfffcXfVvqBorcMmac7fVP3Ple4Q3vmrjiQLd5Zlf5RQH8p6EecqwefUbhKulJRgfDXB_uh1jGvupUDbPeX-v33NQKCN1PdGDmZtihfvSkPILI4kGQRRDTn3aFtt-ne4NyKvF2xrOJEa0wiXPf4zMlK3Q-kK-znF1-k4B)****

After leaving the SEALs, I came back to Arizona and the call to serve came to me once more. I started my own business and began employing veterans within our community.

I'm proud to say we've had a thriving operation for the last 7 years and continue to hire veterans and give back to our community.

I've taken a blood oath to serve this country and my desire to serve others has taken me to the belly of the beast: Congress.

****[PITCH IN NOW](http://links.mwaltzforcongress.com/u/click?_t=d89142ed55974e2696402eb6b29e4daf&_m=f753a90df4ba4dd69bb080e4714f5a09&_e=-BzPPmcR8VKxbjFqpERtHEW43yoWQeIRqVO2s5Ik0mSIQrRVAQVh5LCYspunKsI9O0nlB_tOeQ4SjntAYQAXUHtEkfcCfffcXfVvqBorcMmM8uoWoQMTpdz3TqypcDcQxJyIgJps2AC1GN_dHofp8VfDwgjvtGLGosqHhe_aBs5X6b0tEBu9B1_soOV3reoiB3TroOv5sQ-VtmnTBaOOJaLSggLPP1T8qTEkQTH9zpWq0UStulXy95yniETs6p4k)****

I'm running because the politicians today have forgotten their job title. They are called Representatives for a reason and from what I've seen, most of these bureaucrats think that means representing themselves and not their community.

**I promise you I 'll change that.**

I am not a career politician or a connected D.C. fat-cat. I support the Trump-era policies and want to promote his legacy to the best of my abilities.
* Secure borders
* Protected Second Amendment rights
* Well-funded military
* Lowering taxes
* Election integrity
* Supporting small businesses

I'm going there with a mission and my only focus is success.

****[RUSH IN $20.22](http://links.mwaltzforcongress.com/u/click?_t=d89142ed55974e2696402eb6b29e4daf&_m=f753a90df4ba4dd69bb080e4714f5a09&_e=-BzPPmcR8VKxbjFqpERtHEW43yoWQeIRqVO2s5Ik0mSIQrRVAQVh5LCYspunKsI9O0nlB_tOeQ4SjntAYQAXUHtEkfcCfffcXfVvqBorcMkBJCE8HXQLijUJdM3cn1V52YRAecekCNMqUq13kYTaJl9fBsGtkEi3qYGhTmzhUa2lF4mhzvpsqkLesbYKMirKltjSHcYweJ4207nBPi0XIMSwSiw_Wp44uRO_qnrTph2XSoO-CuROvTQTi8mA7id7)****

Eli Crane

[1]Charles Booker

Hi, it’s Charles Booker, Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Kentucky
against Rand Paul.

Everyone knows that billionaires and big corporations are with my
opponent, not me. But this year, they’re taking their support to a new
level.

Billionaire Jeff Yass (who is from Pennsylvania, by the way) has donated
millions to support Rand Paul. His ads claim that I’m a “radical
socialist” and am waging a “war on American energy.”

I don’t have billionaires bankrolling my campaigns -- I just have you. And
with less than a week remaining in this race, I need you now more than
ever.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18824?t=1001&akid=2709%2E346206%2EwhD8il ]Can you pitch in $20 or more to help me stand up to Rand Paul and the
billionaire class on November 8th?

DONATE NOW →

From: Breaking News KY <info@charlesbooker.org>
Subject: Billionaires are flooding Kentucky with false attack ads against
me
Sent on November 1, 2022 at 3:05 p.m.

Everyone knows that billionaires and big corporations support Rand Paul.

They’re thrilled they have a Senator in Washington who will write them
blank checks, cut their taxes, and look the other way while Republicans
slash Medicaid, Medicare, and Social Security to pay for it.

But Rand Paul is taking it to a new level this year.

Billionaire Jeff Yass (who is from Pennsylvania, by the way) has donated
millions to support one of Rand Paul’s two major super PACs. His ads claim
that Charles Booker is a “radical socialist” and is waging a “war on
American energy.”

Here’s the bottom line: Rand Paul is drawing support from out-of-state
billionaires like Yass because they want to stop Charles Booker from
protecting programs that help poor people -- programs that provide
life-saving medical and financial support.

Charles doesn’t have billionaires bankrolling his campaigns. He only has
you -- a grassroots army of supporters who want a better way forward for
Kentucky.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18824?t=1002&akid=2709%2E346206%2EwhD8il ]With just seven days remaining, he needs your help: Can you pitch in

Team Booker HQ
